jobs.title: Drupal CMS Project Manager / Scrum Master
jobs.description:
Revolutional
delivers advanced technology solutions and mission support to federal agencies across civilian, health, and national security environments. We apply modern capabilities, including AI/ML, cloud, cybersecurity, and IT modernization to solve complex challenges, enable faster and more secure operations, and drive measurable mission outcomes.

We are redefining how federal technology gets built and delivered by operating with a product mindset, prioritizing speed, ownership, and execution over bureaucracy.

Title: Drupal CMS Project Manager / Scrum Master

Location:
Remote

Terms:
Full-time

Salary:
$125-145k DoE

Clearance: Public Trust

Travel: 0%

Position Description

We are seeking a Drupal CMS Project Manager / Scrum Master to join our team. The ideal candidate will have experience leading and managing cross-functional Agile Scrum teams to plan, develop, and launch mission-critical Federal Government web applications and content management systems. The Drupal CMS Project Manager / Scrum Master will oversee the entire project lifecycle, from initial discovery and design through full website build, launch, and post-launch operations, ensuring that all deliverables meet rigorous performance, quality, and security standards.

Responsibilities

Provide overall direction, coordination, implementation, execution, control, and completion of Federal IT web development projects from initial kickoff to final deployment.
Serve as Scrum Master for Agile development teams, facilitating all Scrum ceremonies including sprint planning, daily stand-ups, backlog grooming, sprint reviews, and retrospectives.
Direct the end-to-end management of a new enterprise Drupal Content Management System (CMS) website from initial setup and architecture through go-live and ongoing maintenance.
Coordinate closely with creative design partners, UX/UI specialists, content strategists, and technical teams to ensure seamless visual design integration, web accessibility (Section 508 / WCAG 2.2), and brand alignment.
Manage complex project schedules, assess conflicting priorities, eliminate technical blockers, and track team velocity and project health using key metrics and earned value analysis.
Proactively identify potential project risks and issues, develop mitigation and contingency plans, and maintain a comprehensive risk register.
Ensure all contractual deliverables and performance standards adhere strictly to Quality Assurance Surveillance Plans (QASP) and Federal security and privacy requirements.
Serve as the primary client-facing point of contact, maintaining transparent communication with government stakeholders, Contracting Officer Representatives (CORs), and program managers through weekly status meetings and monthly progress reports.
Foster a collaborative team culture, conducting regular one-on-one meetings, coaching team members, and maintaining high morale across multidisciplinary technical and creative staff.

Requirements

U.S. Citizenship and ability to obtain and maintain a Federal Public Trust clearance.
Bachelor's Degree in Information Technology, Computer Science, Business Administration, or a related field with 8+ years of hands-on experience in project management and Agile best practices.
Experience managing full-lifecycle enterprise web development and CMS deployment projects.
Experience with Drupal CMS
Demonstrated experience facilitating Scrum ceremonies and managing multidisciplinary technical, creative design, and content teams.
Active Project Management Professional (PMP) certification.
Active Agile Certification (e.g., Certified ScrumMaster (CSM) or equivalent experience.
Proficiency with Agile management tools (e.g., Jira) and project scheduling software such as MS Project.
Strong analytical, organizational, client-facing, and oral/written communication skills.

Desired

Experience leading Drupal website development projects from start to launch.
Experience managing and coordinating work with external creative design partners, multimedia agencies, and UX/UI teams.
Experience managing Federal Government Contracts.
Familiarity with Cloud hosting environments (such as AWS or Azure) and cloud deployment workflows.
Familiarity with Artificial Intelligence (AI) technologies, Large Language Models (LLMs), and AI-enabled site features or assistants.
Knowledge of Federal security authorization processes (FISMA, NIST SP 800-53) and Section 508 / WCAG 2.2 web accessibility compliance standards.

Work Authorization/Clearance:
Must be a US Citizen and
have or are able to obtain a Federal Government Public Trust Clearance.

jobs.description:
Project Manager - Project Management / EPC / Gas Processing / RNG / Energy / Gas Pipeline Infrastructure / Landfill / Owner-Operator / ABET #4987

Job Summary

The company is a leader in the capture and conversion of biogas into low carbon intensity renewable natural gas (RNG) and renewable electricity. The company is also a leader in the marketing and distribution of RNG to heavy duty trucking and other hard-to-decarbonize industrial sectors.

We are hiring a Project Manager - Engineering, Procurement & Construction (EPC)
with at least 10 years of experience to join our Upstream Construction Team. This role reports directly to the Director of Engineering, Procurement & Construction (EPC) and is responsible for managing subcontractors performing commercial and industrial construction and engineering projects nationwide.

The ideal candidate will have strong experience with process plant and process piping projects in the oil & gas, refinery, chemical process, biogas, or other related process facility sectors. The Project Manager will oversee projects during development, pre-construction, construction, and commissioning phases, with a focus on safety, budget, schedule, and risk management.

Responsibilities

Manage assigned projects through all phases: development, pre-construction, construction, and commissioning.
Serve as the primary point of contact and maintain consistent, thorough communication with internal and external stakeholders.
Ensure smooth transitions between project phases by coordinating closely with development and operations teams.
Account for overall project safety, scope, budget, risk management, and schedule delivery.
Oversee a mix of project types, including biogas-to-RNG conversion, biogas-to-renewable electricity projects, greenfield development, brownfield redevelopment, and distressed asset rehabilitation using EPC or design-build delivery methods.
Oversee or directly perform key activities such as owner permitting, contracting with consultants and contractors, negotiations and contractual agreements, utility interconnections (natural gas, power, water, sanitary, internet, etc.), land or land rights acquisition, estimating, bidding, equipment procurement, logistics, and material transport.
Ensure compliance with permits, material contracts, lenders, and equity partners, including required reporting.
Manage project costs, schedules, risks, deliverables, tasks, and regular reporting.

Qualifications

Bachelor’s degree (BS) in Electrical, Mechanical, Chemical, or Petroleum Engineering from an ABET-accredited university. Advanced degree (MS or MBA) preferred.
PMP certification preferred but not required.
Minimum 10 years of industrial-scale project management experience.
Demonstrated experience working on gas processing projects such as RNG, gas transmission and compression, gas treating, air separation, LNG, CNG, hydrogen, or related facilities.
Proven ability to adapt and pivot quickly in response to daily changes and project challenges.
Strong working knowledge of project management software such as Autodesk Construction Cloud, Procore, Primavera, or MS Project.
Solid understanding of project controls and contract management.
Experience managing projects with CAPEX greater than $50MM.
Ability to successfully manage concurrent projects across multiple states.
Excellent communication and negotiation skills.
Existing network of vendors, consultants, and contractors across the United States is highly preferred.
Must have relevant project experience within the United States.
Initially, the position is remote with travel but team will prioritize candidates with willingness to relocate to Charlotte area in future.

Compensation Package

Base Salary
: Depending on qualifications, up to $190,000 annually (actual offer will be based on experience, skills, qualifications, market considerations, and geographic location).
Bonus
: Eligible for 20% target performance-based bonus.
Benefits
:
Health Insurance
Dental Insurance
Vision Insurance
Life Insurance
Short & Long Term Disability
401(k) with matching contributions
Tuition Assistance
Referral Bonus
Generous Paid Time Off
Ten Paid Holidays

Work Arrangement
: This role is initially home-based with approximately 30–50% overnight travel required. Candidates must have access to a major airport within one hour of their residence. During plant commissioning, daily on-site presence may be required. Future plans include opening an office in Charlotte, NC; candidates should be open to relocating to the Charlotte area for a hybrid work schedule.

Physical Requirements
: The position requires the ability to perform both office-based and field/site work. Field responsibilities include performing walk-downs at active construction, industrial, or operational sites; walking on uneven surfaces (gravel, dirt, concrete, steel grating, scaffolding); climbing stairs, ladders, and scaffolding; working at heights and in confined spaces; and wearing required PPE (hard hats, safety glasses, steel toe boots, gloves, hearing protection, fall protection, respirators, etc.). The role involves exposure to varying weather conditions, noise, dust, and moving equipment while maintaining strong situational awareness and adherence to safety protocols. Reasonable accommodations may be made for individuals with disabilities.

jobs.title: Technical Program Manager, Growth
jobs.description:
About OnePay

OnePay is the consumer fintech trusted by millions of Americans to make money better.

Our financial system is broken. High fees, low rates, and too few ways to actually grow your money. We’re fixing it. And we’re moving fast.

We’re an all-in-one financial services platform that brings together banking, high-yield savings, credit cards, point-of-sale lending, investing, and crypto in one place. We also partner with employers, HCM providers, gig platforms, and others to deliver embedded financial services to millions of employees and frontline workers.

We’re backed by Walmart, the world’s largest retailer, and Ribbit Capital, one of fintech’s most respected investors, giving us rare scale, distribution, and the opportunity to build something truly category-defining.

But What Really Sets OnePay Apart Is How We Move. Our Customers Don’t Have Time To Wait… And Neither Do We. This Place Moves Fast, And We’re Looking For People Who Are

Ready to run
Hungry and driven by urgency
Exceptional at what they do, with low ego
Comfortable operating in motion

The Role

Our growth stack has a lot of moving parts. The app and the website send events through a customer data platform to the ad platforms, our mobile measurement partners and the data warehouse. Most launches touch several of those systems and a few different teams.

You'll own the growth roadmap and work day to day with the MarTech and growth engineers who build and maintain all of this. Your job is to keep launches moving, make sure they get properly tested, and make sure the numbers on the other side can be trusted.

What You'll Do

Own the growth roadmap. Turn requests from marketing, paid media and product into scoped tickets with clear owners and dates. Keep the roadmap, runbooks and data flow docs current, and automate the repetitive parts with scripts or AI tools.
Lead testing and QA with the MarTech and growth engineers. Write test plans, check changes in staging and on test devices before they ship, and confirm they worked after launch.
Keep data flowing into paid media. Manage customer data platform destinations, audience syncs, reverse ETL and server-side events. Watch for dropped events, low match rates and schema drift, and write or tweak simple scripts when a setting isn't enough.
Own our relationship with the mobile measurement partners. Debug attribution problems, keep SDK and ad network integrations healthy, and handle support escalations, renewals and roadmap requests.
Keep tracking specs consistent across the app, the website, the customer data platform and web analytics, and dig in when numbers from different sources don't match.
Run SDK upgrades, attribution migrations and new vendor onboarding from evaluation through cutover, with a rollback plan.
Support paid and acquisition work across search, social, app-install networks, app store search ads and affiliates, including click ID plumbing, exclusion lists and test setup.
Bring Privacy and Legal in early, so consent, data-sharing limits and data subject requests are part of the plan and not a surprise at launch.

You Bring

8+ years in technical program management, supporting growth, performance marketing, martech or data teams.
Hands-on time with a customer data platform. You've connected it to several ad platforms, mapped and filtered events, and synced audiences with consent rules applied. You can read a tracking plan or a destination config and spot where a launch will break.
Experience with a mobile measurement partner and a good grasp of attribution: click IDs, ATT and SKAdNetwork, view-through versus click-through, and platform-reported versus first-party conversions. You've debugged discrepancies and dealt with the vendor directly.
Experience doing testing and QA with engineers on tracking or integration launches: test plans, staging checks, debug tools, test devices, and regression checks after SDK or release changes.
You write SQL and pull your own numbers.
A track record of running programs across engineering, design, data and marketing, with clear specs, honest status updates and a written record of decisions.
Good judgment on priorities, and comfort saying no. You're fine with ambiguity and with working asynchronously on a remote-first team.

Nice to Have

Experience at a consumer fintech or another regulated company.
Reverse ETL into paid media (conversion APIs, offline conversions, audience uploads) and keeping it healthy: match rates, deduplication, delays and dropped events.
Reading and writing simple scripts in JavaScript or Liquid, for example to transform an event payload or build a template.
Experience with a cloud data warehouse.
A working understanding of marketing privacy rules: consent, CCPA and similar state laws, GLBA, and limits on sharing customer data with ad platforms. You know when to ask Legal.

What We Offer

Competitive base salary, stock options, and health benefits from Day 1
401(k) plan with company match
Remote-friendly (US), flexible time off (FTO), and opportunities for growth
A high-growth, mission-driven, inclusive culture where your work has real impact

Life Sciences, R&D, Laboratories, Clean Rooms, Biotech, Pharma Manufacturing, etc.
Location: Omaha, NE (hybrid!)

We also have an opening for a Director of Life Sciences to join our firm as well. If you are looking for a more senior-level role, let me know! 

This is not an IT Project Manager role! Must-have prior experience in design engineering from Life Sciences side or at an AEC firm. 
We are a globally recognized Architecture, Engineering, and Construction (AEC) firm delivering innovative solutions for some of the world's most technically complex and highly regulated facilities. Our teams partner with leading pharmaceutical, biotechnology, food and beverage, and advanced manufacturing organizations to design and deliver facilities that improve lives, enable innovation, and support operational excellence.
Our integrated approach combines engineering expertise, process knowledge, and project delivery excellence to create world-class manufacturing environments that are safe, sustainable, and efficient.

Position Overview

The Project Manager responsible for leading complex capital projects from concept through handover within the life sciences, food and beverage, and pharmaceutical manufacturing sectors. The role combines design engineering and construction management services with strong client relationship management to deliver safe, compliant, on-time and on-budget facilities. 

Key Responsibilities

Help lead end-to-end project delivery including planning, design, procurement, construction, commissioning and closeout for life sciences and pharma manufacturing facilities.
Develop and implement project execution plans, schedules and budgets; manage scope, valuation, cost control and change management to maintain project financial performance.
Coordinate and oversee design engineering activities across core disciplines (mechanical, electrical, industrial, chemical) and integrate with architecture, process and validation teams.
Provide construction management services on site: supervise contractors, enforce quality and safety standards, resolve construction issues and maintain progress reporting.
Manage client relationships and stakeholder communications; provide regular status updates, negotiate scope and commercial terms, and ensure client requirements are fully met.
Identify, assess and mitigate project risks and technical complexities; lead problem solving and escalation processes to minimize impacts to schedule and cost.
Ensure compliance with regulatory requirements and industry standards (GMP, FDA/EMA expectations, local building and safety codes) and support commissioning/validation activities.
Mentor and lead multidisciplinary project teams, consultants and subcontractors; promote continuous improvement and knowledge sharing across projects.
Oversee procurement strategy and vendor management to secure equipment, materials and services that meet technical and schedule requirements.
Prepare and present executive summaries, forecasts and technical reports for senior management and stakeholders.

Qualifications

Minimum 5 years of progressive project management experience delivering capital projects in life sciences, pharmaceutical manufacturing or AEC sectors, with demonstrated success on complex, high value programs.
Proven experience in design engineering oversight and construction management services across mechanical, electrical, industrial and/or chemical disciplines.
Strong understanding of pharma manufacturing processes, GMP requirements, commissioning and validation practices.
Demonstrated expertise in scope definition, valuation, complexity management, cost control and scheduling on multidiscipline projects.
Exceptional client relationship management skills with experience negotiating scope and commercial terms and maintaining senior stakeholder alignment.
Professional Project Management certification or equivalent is highly desirable.
Proficiency with project controls and collaboration tools (Primavera P6/MS Project, BIM software, cost control systems, MS Office).
Excellent leadership, communication and interpersonal skills; ability to lead multidisciplinary teams and make decisive technical and commercial decisions.
Willingness to travel to project sites as required and ability to obtain necessary site security/clearances.
Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Construction Management, or related field; advanced degree preferred.

jobs.description:
Job Description

Your Impact:

We have an exciting opportunity for a Senior Project Manager to join our team working within a dynamic and fast paced Precision Guidance IPT.

In This Pivotal Role, You Will

Deliver cutting-edge seeker capabilities to UK and international customers.
Maintain and enhance operational systems for our customers.
Oversee the development of next-generation products and low-TRL technologies.
Support business-winning activities to secure future growth.

This position sits within our Sensors Business Area, part of the Integrated Sensing & Protection (ISP) Line of Business (LoB). You will lead multiple world-class projects that have provided specialist capability to the UK MoD for decades—continuing to deliver operational advantage for our armed forces.

As PM/Senior PM, You Will

Be accountable for delivery of specific projects in the portfolio.
Apply strong leadership, governance, and problem-solving skills to deliver multiple complex projects to time, cost, and quality
Lead early-stage technology development projects, managing uncertainty in requirements, technical feasibility, and resource allocation while ensuring alignment with long-term product strategy.
Establish robust governance and risk frameworks for low-TRL initiatives, proactively identifying technical, schedule, and integration risks and implementing mitigation plans to accelerate maturation toward higher TRLs.
Support bids and campaigns spanning the Precision Guidance IPT, increasing their Pwin.
Be responsible for working with the Project Engineering Lead / Project Engineering Managers to manage available resource against future demand based on forecast prospects, ensuring issues are either addressed locally or are escalated to the Head of Programmes & Head of Engineering Projects.
Support the IPTs’ delivery of Low-TRL tasks and the development of internally funded projects to develop next generation products and system enhancements.
Be responsible for Projects internal reporting to the business, including Monthly Project Reviews into VP Sensors and as required, SVP ISP.
Manage and demonstrate improved delivery where possible to improve financial performance against the baseline targets.
Ensure adherence to Company governance and process, including Leonardo’s Lifecycle Management (LCM) as appropriate, including tailoring to suit project requirements.
Proactively monitor cost and schedule progress and lead the team effectively through planning, allocation and reporting of work in order to ensure successful delivery of projects and their objectives.
Anticipate, mitigate and manage dependencies, risks and synergies in support of increased business performance.
Build and maintain strong working relationships with all functions in order to influence, support and deliver projects.
Support the ongoing development and/or improvement of relationships with internal and external customers and suppliers to build on the principals of trust, collaboration and mutual respect.
Provide coaching and mentoring support to members of the IPT, and particularly those within the Project Management function.

Intrinsic Job Factors

Full time role with some out of hours and extended working hours anticipated as required.
This role will be Basildon based. Wider travel to other Leonardo and customer sites may also be required.

What You'll Bring

Proven experience in leading projects, including those at early stages of development where requirements, technologies, and risks are evolving.
Excellent stakeholder management skills, influencing senior leadership and maintaining customer relationships.
Excellent stakeholder engagement skills, influencing senior leadership and building trusted customer relationships.
Deep understanding of product development processes, from concept and low-TRL technology maturation through to sustainment and retirement.
Robust risk and issue management capabilities, with a track record of proactive mitigation in uncertain and dynamic environments.
Leadership and team development experience, fostering collaboration and accountability across multi-disciplinary teams.
Strong governance and delivery discipline, ensuring projects meet scope, schedule, and budget—even in early-phase, high-uncertainty contexts.
Knowledge of compliance standards and regulatory requirements relevant to defence and aerospace.
Exceptional communication and presentation skills, able to simplify complex technical and commercial information for diverse audiences.
Proactive, results-driven mindset, focused on continuous improvement and high performance.
Working knowledge of Lifecycle Management (LCM), Project Execution, Risk Management, and Project Controls.
Experience in business-winning activities, including bid support and campaign planning.
Ability to organise, prioritise, and work autonomously in a fast-paced environment.
Flexible and adaptable to change, with resilience under pressure.
Strong problem-solving skills and lateral thinking, particularly in ambiguous early development phases.
Ability to integrate and communicate across multiple functions and geographically dispersed teams.
Good computer literacy, including Microsoft Office applications.
Ideally APMP, PRINCE-2 or PMI PMP Certified

Security Clearance

This role is subject to pre-employment screening in line with the UK Government’s Baseline Personnel Security Standard (BPSS). An additional range of Personnel Security Controls referred to as National Security Vetting (NSV) may apply, this could include meeting the eligibility requirements for The Security Check (SC) or Developed Vetting (DV). For more information and guidance please visit: https://careers.uk.leonardo.com/gb/en/security-and-vetting

Leonardo UK operates a grade-based salary framework with broad bands. The salary range shown reflects the approved grade band for this role, or a narrower hiring range published within that band, and is benchmarked against the external market. Exceptions above the standard range are managed through governance controls to protect internal equity.

Why join us

At Leonardo, our people are at the heart of everything we do. We offer a comprehensive, company-funded benefits package that supports your wellbeing, career development, and work–life balance. Whether you're looking to grow professionally, care for your health, or plan for the future, we’re here to help you thrive.

Time to Recharge: Enjoy generous leave with the opportunity to accrue up to 12 additional flexi-days each year.
Secure your Future: Benefit from our award-winning pension scheme with up to 15% employer contribution.
Your Wellbeing Matters: Free access to mental health support, financial advice, and employee-led networks championing inclusion and diversity (Enable, Pride, Equalise, Armed Forces, Carers, Wellbeing and Ethnicity).
Rewarding Performance: All employees at management level and below are eligible for our bonus scheme.
Never Stop Learning: Free access to 4,000+ online courses via Coursera and LinkedIn Learning.
Refer a friend: Receive a financial reward through our referral programme.
Tailored Perks: Spend up to £500 annually on flexible benefits including private healthcare, dental, family cover, tech & lifestyle discounts, gym memberships and more.
Flexible working: Flexible hours with hybrid working options. For part time opportunities, please talk to us about what might be possible for this role.

For a full list of our company benefits please visit our website.

Leonardo is a global leader in Aerospace, Defence, and Security. Headquartered in Italy, we employ over 53,000 people worldwide including 8,500 across 9 sites in the UK. jobs.description:
Our mission: eliminating every barrier to mental health.

Spring Health is a global mental health company on a mission to eliminate every barrier to mental health. We're building a world where getting support is simple, personal, and built around the person, so care can continue through every job, move, health plan, and life stage.

Our AI-native platform helps us deliver personalized support across self-guided tools, coaching, therapy, medication management, and specialty care. With outcomes independently validated by JAMA Network Open and the Validation Institute, Spring Health reaches more than 170 million people worldwide through leading employers, health plans, and partners.

As an AI-native company, we believe technology should expand the reach, quality, and humanity of care. Every Spring Health team member is expected to use AI tools thoughtfully, apply human judgment to AI outputs, and keep building AI fluency in ways that support their role and our mission.

Reporting to the Director of Product and working closely with the Product Lead, you will lead complex programs across three critical growth areas: Global, Payer, and Partnerships. You will turn strategic priorities, customer feedback, and partner needs into coordinated plans that teams can deliver. You will also help teams resolve urgent issues, prevent recurring problems, and build an operating model that scales as these businesses grow.

Please note that this is a hybrid role based in New York City, or San Francisco, CA
with an expectation to be in the office 2–3 days per week. Candidates must be based in the NYC or San Francisco metro area or able to relocate independently within 90 days of their start date. Occasional travel will be required for team on-sites.

What You’ll Do

Lead programs from planning through launch, defining milestones, owners, dependencies, risks, and decisions.
Coordinate Product, Engineering, Data, Operations, Support, Partnerships, and other customer-facing teams to deliver on commitments.
Lead responses to urgent issues by establishing their scope, assigning owners, agreeing on next steps and timelines, and keeping stakeholders informed.
Serve as a trusted R&D point of contact for key customers and partner with customer-facing teams to understand and address their needs.
Work with Product and Engineering to identify recurring experience issues, deliver immediate fixes, and prioritize lasting improvements.
Build practical, repeatable ways to triage issues, prioritize work, manage escalations, track risks, and share progress.
Prepare teams for launches and changes by confirming responsibilities, dependencies, risks, testing, and operational readiness.
Develop an operating model that supports a growing portfolio of global, payer, and partner relationships.

What Success Looks Like

Core member experiences across web, mobile, and other touchpoints are regularly audited and proactively monitored against member and customer needs.
Every priority program has a clear delivery plan that accounts for dependencies and improves predictability and time to launch.
Complex programs meet agreed commitments. Scope changes and trade-offs are surfaced early, documented, and resolved with the right stakeholders.
Leaders across Engineering, Product, Customer Success, and Marketing have clear, timely information about progress, risks, and decisions.
Program measures, such as on-time delivery, cycle time, scope stability, defect escape rate, and launch readiness, are defined and improve over time.
Payer programs receive thorough QA and regression testing, supported by a plan to scale those practices as the portfolio grows.
Teams spend less time navigating unclear processes and more time resolving customer needs and delivering work.
Customers and the Payer team feel well supported, especially when issues are urgent or complex.
Partners see program management as a rigorous, practical function that helps teams ship.

What You’ll Bring

5+ years of experience managing complex programs in a technology-driven organization, working closely with engineers and product designers.
Experience partnering with customers and customer-facing teams on B2B or B2B2C products that deliver strong user satisfaction and engagement.
The ability to influence without formal authority, resolve competing priorities, and build trust across teams.
Confidence presenting to and working with senior executives, both internally and with customers.
An analytical, metrics-driven approach grounded in empathy for users.
Comfort navigating ambiguity and change while balancing immediate needs with longer-term goals.
A willingness to work through details as well as set direction.
Excellent written and verbal communication, strong stakeholder relationships, and careful attention to detail.

Bonus Qualifications

Experience working in healthcare.
Experience working on both web and mobile applications.

Note
: We have even more benefits than listed here and below, your recruiter will provide more in-depth information as you continue in the interview process. Benefits are subject to individual plan requirements and eligibility criteria.

Health, Dental, Vision benefits start on your first day at Spring. You and your dependents also receive access to One Medical accounts HSA and FSA plans are also available, with Spring contributing up to $1K for HSAs, depending on your plan type.
Employer sponsored 401(k) match of up to 2% for retirement planning
A yearly allotment of no cost visits to the Spring Health network of therapists, coaches, and medication management providers for you and your dependents.
We offer competitive paid time off policies including vacation, sick leave and company holidays.
At 6 months tenure with Spring, we offer parental leave of 18 weeks for birthing parents and 16 weeks for non-birthing parents.
Access to Noom, a weight management program—based in psychology, that’s tailored to your unique needs and goals.
Access to fertility care support through Carrot, in addition to $4,000 reimbursement for related fertility expenses.
Access to Wellhub, which connects employees to the best options for fitness, mindfulness, nutrition, and sleep in one subscription
Access to BrightHorizons, which provides sponsored child care, back-up care, and elder care
Up to $1,000 Professional Development Reimbursement a year.
$200 per year donation matching to support your favorite causes.

Title: Project Manager (Infrastructure Projects)

Location: White Plains, NY (3 days Onsite)

Duration: 12 months contract

About Cogent Infotech

At Cogent Infotech, we believe in creating opportunities that empower individuals and transform organizations. With over 23 years of excellence in consulting and talent solutions, we pride ourselves on building inclusive workplaces and driving innovation in everything we do. Our diverse teams bring unique perspectives to help deliver cutting-edge solutions to global clients across both public and private sectors.

Position Summary

The Project Manager will be heavily involved in the planning, execution, and oversight of infrastructure projects. This position involves meticulous coordination of project teams, ensuring timely and budget-conscious project delivery, and adeptly managing stakeholder expectations. Collaborating closely with cross-functional teams, vendors, and stakeholders, the Project Manager is instrumental in driving successful project outcomes. The ideal candidate will possess a strong technical background and extensive experience in IT project management, particularly in infrastructure-related initiatives.

Key Responsibilities

Focus on the planning, execution, and delivery of infrastructure projects, ensuring they are completed on time, within budget, and meet the required quality standards.
Skillfully develop project budgets, meticulously tracking expenditures to ensure cost-effectiveness.
Collaborate with cross-functional teams to define project scope, objectives, and deliverables, ensuring alignment with organizational goals and strategic initiatives.
Develop detailed project plans, schedules, and budgets, identifying necessary resources, milestones, and key performance indicators (KPIs) to track project progress and success.
Proactively identify potential risks, issues, and dependencies, and develop mitigation strategies to minimize their impact on project timelines and deliverables.
Effectively communicate project status, risks, and successes to stakeholders, providing regular updates and conducting project reviews as needed.
Foster strong relationships with internal and external stakeholders, including vendors, contractors, and technical teams, ensuring clear communication and collaboration throughout the project lifecycle.
Engage in regular communication with project stakeholders, providing transparent updates, soliciting feedback, and adeptly managing expectations.

Required Qualifications and Skills

Bachelor's degree in Information Technology, Computer Science, Business, or a related field.
Certification in project management (e.g., PMP) is desired. Other possible desired certifications for a project manager working with infrastructure projects may include: ITIL, CompTIA Network+, Cisco, AWS
Minimum of 3-6 years of experience in IT project management, with a focus on infrastructure projects.
Strong technical background and understanding of infrastructure technologies, including network infrastructure, servers, storage, virtualization, cloud services, and security.
Proven track record of successfully delivering complex infrastructure projects on time and within budget
Demonstrated expertise in infrastructure design and planning, server and operating systems management, network infrastructure and protocols, network virtualization, storage systems, cloud infrastructure, network security, monitoring and performance optimization, and vendor management
Excellent communication and stakeholder management abilities, with the capacity to effectively communicate technical concepts to both technical and non-technical audiences.
Strong problem-solving and decision-making skills, with the ability to analyze complex situations, identify solutions, and drive successful outcomes.
Experience with project management methodologies (e.g., Agile, Waterfall) and project management tools (e.g., MS Project, Azure DevOps).
Ability to work in a fast-paced, dynamic environment and manage multiple projects simultaneously.
Thorough understanding of project management phases, techniques and tools: Initiate, Planning: definition/scope/requirements, Execute & Control: scope, work plans, resources, deliverables, Q/A, transition planning, etc, Closure: completion and assessment.
Strong and tested project management skills including: Customer satisfaction management, Sponsor expectation management, Vendor and consultant management, Risk management and issue resolution, Financial management including budgeting, forecasting and reporting, Change Management.
Ability to work cross-functionally to solve problems and implement changes, analyze decisions and actions for their support of the larger area's strategic direction; and work with senior management to resolve more complex problems.
Understanding of the SDLC and other life cycles for the deployment of infrastructure, networking and other non-software projects.

Equal Opportunity & Inclusion Statement

Cogent Infotech is an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment where everyone feels welcome and valued. We encourage applications from individuals of all backgrounds, identities, abilities, and experiences. If you’re excited about this role but don’t meet every requirement, we still encourage you to apply

Application Process

Please submit your resume and a short cover letter through our online portal. Our process includes an initial resume review, a virtual interview, and a short technical assessment. If you need accommodations, feel free to inform us—we are happy to assist.

Join Us

At Cogent Infotech, your ideas matter. Join a purpose-driven organization that celebrates diversity, encourages collaboration, and invests in your future.

About Stratus

Stratus® is an integrated, multi-disciplinary engineering, architecture, interior design, and consulting firm. Consistently ranking among the Top 500 Design Firms in Engineering News-Record, the firm offers a deep bench of industry experts through a highly collaborative approach, delivering innovative solutions across the full project lifecycle. Operating coast to coast, Stratus® serves clients nationwide while maintaining a strategic commitment to supporting high-growth economies and building vibrant communities that foster the professional growth of its team. Serving public- and private-sector clients, the firm is dedicated to delivering the highest-quality service wherever projects take shape. Across the Civic, Commercial, Industrial, Transportation, Education, Water Resources, and Government sectors, we bring precision, insight, and purpose to every project, from targeted renovations to large-scale infrastructure. Stratus® designs spaces, systems, and solutions that perform, endure, and make an impact, delivering on our promise of Better Plans. Better Places.

The Role

The Project Manager is responsible for overseeing the delivery of engineering projects by managing scope, schedule, and budget. This role involves coordinating multidisciplinary teams, ensuring that projects meet client expectations, and maintaining compliance with industry standards. The Project Manager leads the project from conception to completion, ensuring technical excellence and successful project delivery.

Responsibilities

Lead engineering projects from initial concept development through construction completion, ensuring that project goals, timelines, and budgets are met.
Develop and maintain project schedules, budgets, and resource allocation plans, ensuring that all project activities are aligned with client and business objectives.
Manage and lead a team of 4-5 engineers.
Serve as the primary point of contact for clients, providing regular updates on project progress, managing expectations, and addressing concerns.
Coordinate with internal teams, consultants, and contractors to ensure the seamless integration of civil or mechanical systems into the overall project design.
Oversee the preparation of engineering drawings, calculations, and technical documents, ensuring accuracy and adherence to industry standards and client requirements.
Conduct regular project meetings to review progress, identify risks, and develop strategies to ensure timely project delivery and compliance with technical requirements.
Assist in managing project financials, tracking expenses, approving invoices, and ensuring that the project remains profitable.
Manage project resources to deliver projects on schedule, efficiently, and with quality.
Collaborate with senior leadership and business development teams to pursue new project opportunities and contribute to proposal writing and client presentations.
Ensure that all project activities comply with building codes, safety standards, and regulatory requirements, managing the permitting process as needed.
Mentor and support junior engineers and project managers, providing guidance on project management best practices and technical solutions.
Ensure proper project closeout activities, including punch list resolution, final inspections, and post-occupancy evaluations.
Participate in business development efforts, assisting with proposals, client meetings, and presentations to secure new business opportunities.

Qualifications

Bachelor's degree in Engineering from an ABET-accredited university or a related field.
5-7+ years of experience in design engineering, project management, or engineering consulting.
Demonstrated success managing multiple projects simultaneously while meeting schedule, budget, and quality objectives.
Proficiency in project management software (e.g., Deltek, Microsoft Project, Primavera P6).
Experience identifying project risks, assessing potential impacts, and implementing effective mitigation strategies.
Proven leadership skills with the ability to guide teams through complex projects and make sound decisions in fast-paced environments.
Experience mentoring technical staff and fostering collaboration across multidisciplinary teams.
Strong understanding of project delivery, from planning and design through construction and closeout.

Why you’ll love Stratus

A team-oriented environment that values transparency, creativity, and shared success
Meaningful career paths, leadership opportunities, and space to specialize
Learning & Development – Education and Professional Licensing
We believe flexible, hybrid work supports the balance and well-being our team deserves
Excellent Health Care Programs – Medical, Dental, and Vision Insurance
Company-paid Life Insurance, Short-Term Disability, and Long-Term Disability
Voluntary Life Insurance options for employees, spouses, and dependents
401k Retirement Plan with employer match
Paid Holidays & Competitive PTO plans

Interested in learning more about Stratus, please visit https://www.stratusteam.com/

We do this by collaborating with our clients, developing strategies, products and services to support the financial well-being of their more than 5 million diverse customers in communities across Canada. For more information, visit www.central1.com.

What we offer:

Work-life flexibility
Hybrid work environment
Variable annual incentive plan
Generous annual vacation allotment
Top-notch flexible benefits plan including family building and gender affirmation
Retirement Plan, matched contributions at 6%
Access to a learning platform and educational assistance support
Access to a virtual wellness platform
Career development opportunities
Wellness Flex Fund to support personal interest and activities
Day off to volunteer in your community and other paid time off options
Corporate discounts

*subject to employment agreement

Job Summary:

As a Project Manager, Payments Delivery on Central 1’s Client Delivery team, you’ll play a key role in delivering online banking and payment solutions that matter to clients. Working as a trusted partner, you’ll collaborate with clients and internal delivery teams to turn business needs into effective, high-impact software implementations.

You’ll bring hands-on experience within a financial institution and a strong understanding of payment systems.

What you’ll be doing:

Client & Project Delivery

Work directly with clients to support implementations from kickoff through launch, independently or as part of a project team.
Manage multiple projects or client initiatives at the same time.
Act as a key point of contact for clients throughout the project lifecycle, providing clear updates on progress, timelines, and budgets.
Identify, track, and resolve project risks and issues to ensure successful delivery.

Discovery, Requirements & Documentation

Lead or participate in discovery sessions to understand client needs and business requirements.
Create Statements of Work (SOWs), requirements documentation, impact analyses, and change orders as needed.
Define and support product vision for complex, high-impact implementations.
Develop, update, and maintain implementation and user guides.

Technical & Engineering Collaboration

Partner closely with engineering teams by clarifying requirements, answering questions, and validating solutions as they are developed.
Translate business and client needs into clear, actionable requirements for engineering execution.

Testing, Deployment & Launch

Coordinate functional, regression, and user acceptance testing (UAT).
Manage deployments to QA environments and support clients through UAT and go-live activities.
Create launch plans and coordinate all launch-related activities.

Financial & Operational Management

Track projects through each phase of the lifecycle using internal tools and systems.
Review and ensure accuracy of project timesheets across multiple teams.
Prepare monthly billing to reflect revenue earned for active initiatives.
Monitor project budgets and expenditures to ensure work stays within scope.

Team Leadership & Collaboration

Coordinate and guide Implementation Analysts on larger or more complex projects.
Share implementation knowledge, best practices, and product expertise with team members.
Collaborate with the Client Development team to support strong, long-term client relationships.

Post-Implementation Support

Provide post-launch support to clients and internal teams as needed.
Close out projects upon completion, including final billing and documentation.

What you’ll have:

A university degree in computer science, business, or other related discipline with an IT focus.
5+ years relevant experience and 3+ years consulting and/or project management experience.
Financial Services background is preferred, especially in digital, online banking platforms technology services.
Business analysis and Project Management work experience required. CBAP or PMP designation is an asset.
Able to build and maintain strong client relationships.
Works collaboratively and contributes in a team environment.
Able to prioritize and work to schedules
Adapts and responds to changing priorities and business needs.
Strong analytical, problem solving, planning, organizational and time management skills.
Communicates effectively orally and in writing, with clients, technical teams and co-workers.
Ability to manage multiple projects with conflicting deadlines in a team environment.

Salary range:
$70,000-$90,000

The salary represents the job rate determined for the successful candidate who is fully competent in the role. The actual salary will vary depending on market conditions and relevant job-related factors such as knowledge, skills, qualifications, experience, and education/training.

jobs.description:
Department:
Façade Access

Location: Highlands Ranch, CO; Las Vegas, NV; Houston, TX; Atlanta, GA

Lerch Bates is seeking a Project Manager to join our Façade Access Group (FACG). In this role, you will support and manage projects involving façade access systems, building maintenance equipment (BMU), suspended access systems, davits, roof anchors, fall protection systems, and other building access solutions for new and existing buildings.

As a Project Manager, you will work closely with consultants, technical specialists, building owners, architects, developers, contractors, and facility managers to deliver consulting, design, inspection, certification, and project management services. You'll oversee multiple projects simultaneously while serving as a key point of contact for clients and project stakeholders, helping ensure projects are delivered on time, within budget, and to the highest quality standards.

This position is ideal for professionals who enjoy a combination of technical problem-solving, client interaction, project management, construction coordination, and consulting within the architecture, engineering, and construction industry.

About Lerch Bates

Lerch Bates (LB) is a global technical consulting firm focused on improving how buildings perform for owners, designers, and the people who use them every day. For more than 75 years we’ve partnered on some of the world’s most complex and high-profile projects. Today we provide Total Building Performance expertise that integrates Building Science and Building Flow into a unified delivery model.

Our work spans design, construction, investigation, repair, rehabilitation, management, and modernization with one consistent goal: helping clients make confident, well-informed decisions in an increasingly complex built environment.

We are 100% employee-owned through our ESOP. That means when the company succeeds, our employee-owners share in that success. It's more than a retirement benefit—it's an ownership mindset backed by the opportunity to build long-term financial value while helping shape the future of the company.

What You’ll Do

The duties listed below are intended only as illustrations of the various types of work that may be performed in this position. They are not intended to prescribe or restrict the assignments that management may make.

Project Management & Client Support

Manage multiple façade access and building maintenance equipment projects through all phases of the project lifecycle.
Coordinate project scope, schedules, deliverables, budgets, and client communication.
Lead or participate in project meetings with clients, architects, contractors, consultants, and project stakeholders.
Proactively communicate project status, risks, recommendations, and schedule updates.
Build strong client relationships and identify opportunities to expand services within existing accounts.
Support business development efforts and contribute to the continued growth of the Façade Access Group.

Technical Consulting & Design

Prepare technical reports, studies, and project documentation including Basis of Design reports, site survey reports, cost analyses, bid comparisons, certifications, and recommendations.
Develop performance-based drawing packages and plans of service for façade access and building maintenance systems.
Prepare specifications, calculations, design documents, and technical information packages.
Research, interpret, and apply applicable industry codes, standards, regulations, and best practices.
Collaborate with internal consultants, technicians, and project teams to develop practical and effective solutions.

Field Services & Quality Assurance

Conduct site surveys, inspections, and field observations.
Perform quality assurance reviews to verify conformance with contract documents, manufacturer requirements, industry standards, and project objectives.
Document observations, deficiencies, and recommendations through clear and accurate reporting.
Support certification, inspection, repair, maintenance, and installation-related projects.
Travel periodically to project sites across the United States as required.

Project Financial Management

Manage project financial performance with support from Project Coordinators and Project Analysts.
Assist with project setup, forecasting, invoicing, budgeting, and closeout documentation.
Monitor project progress against scope, schedule, and budget objectives.
Help maintain profitability and operational efficiency while delivering exceptional client service.

What You’ll Bring

Bachelor's degree in Construction Management, Architecture, Engineering, or a related field preferred.
Alternatively, 10+ years of project management experience in the construction industry may be considered in lieu of a degree.
1-3+ years of experience within architecture, engineering, construction, consulting, building maintenance equipment, façade access, building envelope, or a related industry.
Strong project management skills with the ability to manage multiple priorities and deadlines simultaneously.
Ability to communicate complex technical information through written reports, presentations, and client discussions.
Excellent technical writing, documentation, and organizational skills.
Strong problem-solving and analytical abilities with the capacity to develop practical solutions.
Ability to work independently while contributing to a collaborative team environment.
Demonstrated commitment to quality, consistency, accuracy, and attention to detail.
Strong interpersonal skills and the ability to build relationships with clients, contractors, consultants, and team members.
Working knowledge of construction documents, design drawings, and technical specifications.
Ability to adapt to changing project requirements and business priorities.
Strong proficiency with Microsoft Office and other project-related software tools.
Willingness to travel domestically as needed to support project and client requirements.

Preferred Qualifications

Experience with façade access systems, building maintenance units (BMUs), suspended access systems, davits, roof anchors, fall protection, or related building access equipment.
Experience preparing technical reports, drawings, specifications, or construction documentation.
Knowledge of applicable OSHA regulations, industry standards, and façade access requirements.
Experience coordinating design, construction, inspection, or certification projects.
Exposure to consulting environments and client-facing project management responsibilities.

Why Work with Lerch Bates?

Competitive base salary of $75,000 - $95,000 per year, based on experience, qualifications, and location
Annual performance-based bonus opportunity, with target incentive levels varying by position and based on individual and company performance.
100% Employee-Owned ESOP (company-funded retirement benefit that allows eligible employees to share in the company's long-term success)
Health, dental, and vision insurance
Paid time off (starting at 17 days annually)
10 paid holidays
401(k) with 6% employer match
Paid parental leave
Professional development and tuition reimbursement
Employee assistance and wellness programs

Become an Employee-Owner

One of the biggest advantages of working at Lerch Bates is that we are 100% employee-owned through our Employee Stock Ownership Plan (ESOP).

Unlike many companies that offer only a salary and retirement plan, eligible employees receive company-funded ESOP shares at no cost to them as part of their long-term retirement benefits.

As Lerch Bates grows, employee-owners share in the company's success. For many employees, the ESOP becomes one of the most valuable financial benefits of their career by helping build meaningful long-term wealth in addition to their salary and traditional 401(k).

When you join Lerch Bates, you are not just building better buildings. You also have the opportunity to build your financial future alongside the company's success.

Core Values

Ownership

Community
Integrity
Respect
Optimism

Working Environment

This position is performed in a combination of office, client, and field environments. Work regularly takes place in occupied buildings, active construction sites, mechanical rooms, elevator machine rooms, elevator pits, hoistways, and other vertical transportation spaces.

Travel throughout the assigned service area is required.

Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable qualified individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions of the position.

Physical Demands

This position requires frequent standing, walking, climbing stairs and ladders, bending, kneeling, crouching, reaching, and navigating active construction sites and existing buildings.

Employees may be required to work at heights, access elevator machine rooms, elevator pits, hoistways, rooftops, and other confined spaces while wearing appropriate PPE. The position may require lifting or carrying equipment weighing up to 40 pounds.

Travel by automobile and occasional air travel may be required.

Mental Demands

This position requires strong analytical, organizational, and technical problem-solving skills. Employees must interpret technical drawings, specifications, maintenance records, inspection reports, and applicable codes and standards while exercising sound professional judgment.

The role requires managing multiple projects, coordinating with clients and contractors, preparing technical reports, and communicating complex technical information clearly to both technical and non-technical audiences.

jobs.description:
About ActiveViam

ActiveViam, a global leader in Big Data analytics and Fintech, is a premier software development firm with offices in New York, London, Singapore, Hong Kong, Sydney, and Paris, and is looking to add to its growing staff.

Our customers are some of the largest banks, hedge funds and asset managers worldwide.  

Our exclusive AI powered technology, Atoti, offers a unique answer to the challenges of risk management, real-time data analytics and complex decision-making, while our commitment to service ensures our solutions are delivered with the same outcome of quick and precise results. 

Our community edition software is used by data scientists in a variety of other verticals building industrialized solutions in Python and Jupyter notebooks.

About The Role

We are looking for a Project Manager to join our Operations team and support the delivery of strategic initiatives across ActiveViam. The role will work across Product, Engineering, Sales, Marketing and Operations, providing the project management discipline needed to keep cross-functional initiatives moving. You will work closely with the Head of Project Management, helping to maintain a clear view of plans, milestones, actions, risks and dependencies and ensuring that decisions and commitments are followed through. We are also developing how we use AI and automation within project and programme management. A key part of the role will be looking for opportunities to reduce manual administration, improve the quality of project information and make better use of the systems and data we already have. This role would suit someone with strong project management foundations who is comfortable working in a technology environment and wants exposure to a broad range of strategic and operational initiatives.

Key responsibilities

Project and programme management

Support the planning and delivery of cross-functional strategic initiatives.
Maintain project plans, milestones, actions, risks, issues and dependencies.
Track delivery against agreed dates and follow up with accountable owners.
Identify blockers or conflicting information and escalate these appropriately.
Coordinate inputs across multiple teams and stakeholders.
Support requirements gathering, documentation and traceability through to delivery.
Maintain clear and accurate project documentation.
Support project governance meetings, including preparation, decisions, actions and follow-up.
Help ensure agreed ways of working and governance processes are consistently followed.

Jira and Confluence

Maintain project and programme information within Jira and Confluence.
Ensure actions, requirements, milestones and delivery information remain current and traceable.
Work with Product and Engineering teams to understand delivery progress and dependencies.
Help improve the quality and consistency of information held within project and product management tools.
Produce useful project and management reporting from the information held within these systems.

Reporting and analysis

Prepare concise status updates for senior stakeholders and governance forums.
Bring together information from different teams to provide a clear view of progress.
Support the preparation of executive and programme reporting.
Analyse project information to identify emerging risks, dependencies or areas requiring attention.
Maintain evidence behind project status and key delivery milestones.

AI and continuous improvement

Use AI tools to support project administration, analysis and reporting.
Identify manual activities that could be simplified or automated.
Help test and implement AI-enabled project management workflows.
Work with colleagues across the business to understand how existing AI capabilities could improve project and programme delivery.
Support the development of repeatable processes and templates that can be used across strategic initiatives.
Look for opportunities to improve project management discipline without introducing unnecessary process or bureaucracy.

Essential Skills And Experience

3–5 year’s experience in project management, programme support, PMO, business analysis or a similar role.
Practical experience working in a technology, fintech, financial services or related environment.
Hands-on experience using Jira and Confluence to manage project or product delivery.
A recognised project management qualification or certification, such as PRINCE2, APM, AgilePM, Scrum or equivalent.
Good understanding of core project management disciplines, including planning, milestones, dependencies, risks, issues and change.
Experience coordinating activity across multiple teams and stakeholders.
Ability to take complex or incomplete information and structure it clearly.
Strong written and verbal communication skills.
Confidence following up on commitments and working with people at different levels of an organisation.
Good analytical and problem-solving skills.
Strong attention to detail while retaining sight of the overall objective.
An active interest in AI and how it can be applied to improve ways of working.
A willingness to learn and develop knowledge of ActiveViam’s products, clients and markets.

Would be an advantage

Experience working within fintech, capital markets, investment management, risk management or financial technology.
Familiarity with financial services products, investment workflows or risk concepts.
Experience supporting Product and Engineering teams and working with software development lifecycles.
Experience working within Agile delivery environments.
Experience with requirements gathering and translating business requirements into structured delivery inputs.
Experience producing reporting for senior management or executive governance.
Experience using AI tools such as ChatGPT, Copilot or other generative AI applications as part of day-to-day work.
Exposure to automation, workflow tools or AI agents.
Experience working in a growing or changing organisation where processes are still being developed.

The person

We are looking for someone who is organised, proactive and comfortable taking responsibility for their work. You should be curious and willing to understand the context behind what you are being asked to do rather than simply completing a task. You will need to be comfortable moving between different initiatives, working with incomplete information and adapting as priorities change. You should also be willing to challenge existing ways of working. We want good project management discipline, but we do not want process for the sake of process. Where something can be simplified, automated or done more effectively, we want someone who will identify it and help improve it. Most importantly, we are looking for someone with the willingness and ability to learn. You will be given exposure to different parts of the business, senior stakeholders and complex strategic initiatives, with the opportunity to take on greater responsibility as the role develops.

What We Offer

Competitive salary and benefits package.
Opportunity to work in a fast-paced international environment with real breadth of exposure.
A collaborative, high-performance team with a clear path for progression.
Hybrid working arrangements (3 days in the office).

Notion is looking for a Recruiting Program Manager to help design, build, and scale the systems and programs that power how we hire. This is a role for someone who moves fast, takes ownership, and doesn't wait to be told what to do — someone who operates with both strategic altitude and operational precision, and knows how to bring clarity and momentum to complex cross-functional work.

We're at an inflection point in how we think about recruiting at Notion, and this role sits at the center of it. This role can be based in either San Francisco or New York City. We work from our offices on Mondays, Tuesdays and Thursdays (our Anchor Days) because we do our best thinking and building together in person. We’re looking for someone who’s excited to work alongside the team during those days.

jobs.title: Project Manager - Track and Systems
jobs.description:
Overview

Ramos CS, now part of Colliers Engineering & Design, is an engineering, program, and construction management firm providing quality transit, transportation, and infrastructure consulting services on public projects across the Western United States. We focus our solutions on mobility-related projects that serve the needs of our communities within the municipal, transit, transportation, airport, and port sectors.

With a staff of diversified, licensed professionals, our philosophy stems from the idea that successful project execution starts with people.

We are seeking a Project Manager for Trackwork and Systems to lead the Construction Management Consultant (CMC) team as Owner's Representative on a light rail extension program's trackwork and systems construction contract. The Project Manager is the primary point of contact for the Authority's Project Manager and is accountable for the CMC's scope, staffing, budget, schedule, and deliverables through both the preconstruction and construction phases. The contract includes trackwork and special trackwork, walkways, duct banks, traction power substations (TPSS), train control, communications architecture, fiber topology, at-grade guideways, and associated civil work. The Project Manager directs the Resident Engineer and Construction Engineers in administering the work in accordance with the applicable Design Criteria Manual, Construction Management Manual, and all governing specifications, and proactively manages risk, interfaces, and change to protect quality, schedule, and budget.

Responsibilities

Serves as the primary point of contact between the CMC team and the Authority's Project Manager, Construction Manager, and executive leadership.
Holds overall responsibility for the CMC contract, including scope, staffing plans, budget, schedule, subconsultant agreements, invoicing, and monthly progress reporting.
Prepares and maintains the CMC Project Management Plan, organization chart, internal schedule, and internal budget.
Directs the Resident Engineer, Deputy Resident Engineer, Construction Engineers, and Interface and Integration Manager to ensure integrated delivery across track, civil, and systems disciplines.
Supports the Authority during the preconstruction phase with design coordination, constructability, biddability, and value engineering reviews, and with development of contract special conditions and Division 01 specifications.
Supports the Authority in GC/CM negotiations, including independent cost estimates and Maximum Allowable Construction Cost (MACC) negotiation support, as requested.
Coordinates with other Construction Management Consultants, design consultants, and the Program Management Support Services consultant to manage inter-contract interfaces, milestones, and handover conditions.
Oversees review of contractor baseline schedules, schedule updates, schedules of values, and progress payment applications.
Oversees the change management process, including review of contractor change requests, independent estimates, negotiations, and change order documentation.
Supports the Authority in the identification, analysis, and resolution of contractor disputes and claims, and elevates unresolved issues as appropriate.
Champions the CMC safety and quality programs, including the field safety and security management plan and the Project Quality Management Plan.
Coordinates with third parties, utilities, and Authorities Having Jurisdiction as directed by the Authority.
Oversees testing, commissioning, safety certification, and contract closeout support activities.
May act as the Authority's primary representative on the project, and establishes standards for meeting minutes, records, and project documentation.
Facilitates coordination with other Authority divisions and regulatory agencies, such as FTA, SHPO, and EPA, as appropriate.
Coordinates messaging plans, notices, and contingency planning as needed.
Supports and documents compliance with sustainability and certification requirements by consultants, contractors, and Authority staff.
Ensures CMC and subconsultant staff are trained on and meet Authority requirements, and oversees day-to-day project activities.
Ensures conformance with all Program contract documents and Authority policies and procedures.

Qualifications

Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Construction Management, Architecture, Transportation, Planning, or a related technical field required.
Relevant professional licensure strongly preferred, such as Professional Engineer (PE; Washington PE preferred), PMP, DBIA, LEED, or Envision.
Approximately 15+ years of relevant experience, with construction management on light rail, heavy rail, or transit capital programs.
Experience managing a multi-disciplinary construction management team on public transit programs of at least $100M in value.
Working knowledge of rail systems scopes, including traction power, train control, and communications.
GC/CM, CM/GC, or CMAR preconstruction experience preferred.
Must be able to work on-site in Seattle: a minimum of three days per week in the Authority's office during preconstruction, and full-time at site offices during construction.
Ability to read, write and understand English for purposes of comprehending written job-related communications and verbal instructions and interactions.

Compensation: $165,000 to $270,000 per year (depending on qualifications)

What We Offer

Ramos Consulting Services, now a part of Colliers Engineering & Design, offers competitive benefits that support our employees in their life and career. This position is eligible for company benefits including but not limited to:

Employer-Provided Healthcare: 100% employer-paid medical, dental, and vision insurance for employee base plans. We also provide a 40% employer contribution toward dependent or family coverage plans.
Paid Time Off: 120 hours of combined PTO and Sick Time annually, in addition to paid holidays.
Retirement Planning: Participation in a 401(k) retirement plan with a generous company match of 50% on the first 6% of employee contributions.
Flexible Spending Accounts: Pre-tax FSA/HSA options for medical, dental, and dependent care expenses to help manage out-of-pocket costs.
Employee Wellness & Support: 100% employer-paid Employee Assistance Program (EAP) providing 24/7 confidential support for work-life balance, financial wellness, and emotional well-being.
National Resources & Career Growth: As part of the Colliers Engineering & Design national platform, employees have access to expanded technical resources, mentorship, and diverse career development opportunities across the Western United States and beyond.

Fanatics is building a leading global digital sports platform. We ignite the passions of global sports fans and maximize the presence and reach for our hundreds of sports partners globally by offering products and services across Fanatics Commerce, Fanatics Collectibles, and Fanatics Betting & Gaming, allowing sports fans to Buy, Collect, and Bet. Fanatics has an established database of over 100 million global sports fans; a global partner network with approximately 900 sports properties, including major national and international professional sports leagues, players associations, teams, colleges, college conferences and retail partners, 2,500 athletes and celebrities, and 200 exclusive athletes; and over 2,000 retail locations, including its Lids retail stores. Our more than 22,000 employees are committed to relentlessly enhancing the fan experience and delighting sports fans globally.

About The Role

At Fanatics Core, we build the secure, scalable platform that powers sports fans everywhere. As we grow into new international markets, we need a senior technical leader to turn our expansion strategy into launches that happen on time and stay compliant.

As Senior Staff TPM for International Expansion, you’ll own the technical program for taking Fanatics Core into new markets around the world. Manage vendors and third-party integrations. Run technical delivery with external partners such as payment providers, identity verification, geolocation, content/data feeds and local hosting. Hold them to timelines, SLAs and compliance obligations.

Align senior stakeholders. Build strong relationships inside and outside Engineering. Communicate clearly with executives on status, risks, trade-offs and decisions across multiple concurrent market programs.
Lead with data. Define and report on the KPIs that measure expansion progress and health, such as time-to-market, launch readiness, compliance findings and post-launch stability.

Overview

At Credence, we support our clients' mission-critical needs, powered by technology. We provide cutting-edge solutions, including AI/ML, enterprise modernization, and advanced intelligence capabilities, to the largest defense and health federal organizations. Through partnership and trust, we increase mission success for war-fighters and secure our nation for a better future. 
We are privately held, are repeatedly recognized as a top place to work, and have been on the Inc. 5000 Fastest Growing Private Companies list for the last 12 years. We practice servant leadership and believe that by focusing on the success of our clients, team members, and partners, we all achieve greater success. 
Credence has an immediate opening for a Senior Program Manager who will be primarily responsible for supporting the Air Force Life Cycle Management Center WAM (AFLCMC/WAM) directorate, F-16 division at WPAFB, OH. 
F-16 "Viper" AFLCMC/WAM is headquartered at Hill Air Force Base with units located at Wright-Patterson Air Force Base, Tyndall Air Force Base, Eglin Air Force Base, and Davis-Monthan Air Force Base.  The F-16 "Viper" is a multi-role fighter jet delivering air-to-air, air-to-ground, and surveillance capabilities for the United States Air Force (USAF) and Coalition Partners.
The F-16 program has the largest Foreign Military Sales (FMS) program in U.S. history producing over 4,500 jets for 24 countries.  Each F-16 FMS case is uniquely tailored to country requirements / development / funding.  Presently, FMS production orders exist through 2030. Additionally, the F-16 program includes the Multi-National Fighter Program (MNFP). MNFP is not a typical FMS program, but a unique, cooperative USAF and development program implemented through the FMS process under the framework of a Memorandum of Understanding (MOU). MNFP began in 1975 with the countries of Belgium, Denmark, the Netherlands, and Norway; Portugal joined in 2000.

Assist in risk management, cost, schedule, and performance of various software development efforts in a program management role, and report on them monthly through use of the Project Management Resource Tool (PMRT).

 Advise and assist the Government with complex program management tasks, coordinating and managing multiple contracts, and identifying and confirming the annual funding requirements for those contracts
Assist with project cost estimates and have knowledge of the system engineering process and project Configuration Management (CM) requirements.
Assist to investigate, analyze, plan, design, develop, implement, and evaluate solutions for project / program efforts; provide expert-level issue resolution and recommendation support to achieve desired program outcomes to situations that may include, but not be limited to, the following functional areas: program management, logistics, maintenance, supply, financial management (FM), test, security management, information management, and contracting.

The Contractor shall complete program technical assessments and assist with developing cost estimates in support of the integration and software-development programs.  The Contractor shall support Government/Contractor work-share agreements between LM Aero to organic software development at OO-ALC, for development efforts and support complex subsystem integration/coordination for advanced sensors, weapons, and electronic warfare equipment
