jobs.title: Senior Research Analyst, AI Transformation Best Practices
jobs.description:
Gravity Research is hiring a Senior Research Analyst
to help some of the world’s leading communications and corporate affairs teams navigate the rapidly changing world of AI.

This is a role for someone who is endlessly curious about what AI can do, eager to experiment with the latest tools, and excited to turn emerging ideas and peer experiences into practical solutions. You’ll work alongside senior executives to research how leading organizations move from simply experimenting with AI to fundamentally changing how their teams work, and help others follow their lead.

Gravity Research, born of National Journal, is a premier custom research and insights organization supporting corporate clients. Our mission is to help communications and corporate affairs leaders modernize their functions by finding where AI fits into their workflows and team structures.

Background

We are looking for curious and innovative researchers interested in helping communications and corporate affairs leaders smartly navigate AI’s transformation of their function through rigorous case study and best practices research.

The Role

Senior Analysts are responsible for contributing to all aspects of Gravity’s new AI transformation practice, with a focus on case study and best practices research. Analysts help communications and corporate affairs leaders move their teams from early experimentation to mature AI adoption. Analysts on this team use qualitative research methods to assess where organizations stand in their adoption journey, build step-by-step case studies and best practices, and create practical implementation guidance on how to modernize the function. Analysts work directly with senior leaders at Gravity and senior communications and corporate affairs executives at member organizations.

Qualifications Of The Ideal Candidate

The ideal candidate is a strong qualitative researcher who is comfortable designing executive interviews and turning the findings into polished, practical insight. The candidate will also have hands-on comfort with AI tools and prompting, along with the curiosity to test how new tools can improve communications work. The candidate will have the ability to execute against tight deadlines to develop professional and intellectually sound deliverables for members, both independently and in close collaboration with team members.

Your Responsibilities Will Include

Designing in-depth interviews with senior executives and practitioners, and synthesizing the results into organized notes that capture key learnings.
Developing research using qualitative methods to synthesize findings from interviews, surveys, and open-source research into clear, actionable insights and best practices.
Writing and editing detailed step-by-step case studies and roadmaps that translate peer and expert insights into practical implementation plans clients can act on.
Constantly experimenting with new AI tools and releases to understand first-hand how they can be used to improve communications workflows.
Applying change management principles to help clients structure adoption roadmaps, training plans, and upskilling programs for teams navigating AI-enabled ways of working.
Drafting deliverables, including PowerPoint presentations, memos, and other formats, to communicate findings and recommendations to clients.
Supporting the design and delivery of monthly webinars, executive briefings, and training sessions that build AI capability across a client's team.
Preparing briefing materials and research summaries for executive advisors ahead of member meetings, and responding to subsequent questions.
Contributing to product development by crafting new and innovative approaches to producing the analytic work, optimizing operations, and perfecting the research product.
To perform this job successfully, each essential competency and responsibility must be performed satisfactorily. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable an individual with disabilities to perform essential functions. Other duties may be assigned to meet organizational goals.

Specific Qualifications Include

A highly analytic, natural problem solver.
Demonstrated experience conducting qualitative research, including designing interviews and synthesizing findings into clear conclusions.
The ability to highlight key insights within a complex set of data, synthesize large amounts of information, and then clearly explain these insights to clients.
Creative thinking and resourcefulness in problem-solving.
Experience creating case studies, benchmarking reports, white papers, or other client-facing research products is highly preferred.
A skilled project manager, able to independently manage competing priorities and adhere to timelines.
Familiarity with change management fundamentals and the ability to apply them practically to drive team adoption of new tools and workflows.
Hands-on experience using AI tools and prompting (e.g., ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini, Copilot).
An individual with 1-3 years of experience in at least one of the following domains: case study or best practices research, change management, organizational development, AI transformation, or a related field.
Research focused on AI, organizational development, or the future of work preferred.
Earned Bachelor's degree required.
Entrepreneurial spirit; Track record of building new initiatives from conception to execution.
Prodigious work ethic and spirit of generosity.

$70,000 - $85,000 a year

The salary range for this role is $70,000-$85,000, commensurate with experience.

Start Date:
Available immediately

Employment Type:
Full-time

Location:
This job is based in Washington, DC. Gravity Research operates on a hybrid schedule, with employees required to be in the office every Tuesday, Wednesday, and Thursday.

______________________________________________________________________________________________________________

About Us

Across Gravity Research, generally, the firm looks for three “pillar gifts” in you, and everyone else. In all of us, these are more aspirational than actual, but they are central in our intentions –

Force of Ideas:
At the center of Gravity Research’s work are the ideas within our work. We believe that ideas—the good and not—have consequences. Our ultimate objective is to bring rigor, insight, and intellectual honesty to the goal of separating the bad from the good, and giving voice, argument, and flight to maintaining the latter.

Spirit of Generosity:
Gravity Research seeks in its ranks a spirit of generosity: a natural disposition in each colleague toward service and selfless conduct. Our writing should be cut from the same cloth—critical on the merits, but informed by charity and forbearance in measuring motive and personal character.

Radical Responsibility:
We give our people a lot of responsibility early on, and our top performers embrace it. We believe in holding ourselves and our colleagues accountable, taking ownership over big things, striving for excellence, and celebrating success.

Gravity Research is an Equal Opportunity Employer. We do not discriminate against our applicants because of race, color, religion, sex (including gender identity, sexual orientation, and pregnancy), national origin, age, disability, veteran status, genetic information, or any other status protected by applicable law.

These tools assist our recruitment team but do not replace human judgment. Final hiring decisions are ultimately made by humans. jobs.description:
Job Description

This highly visible principal individual contributor role requires the ability to move between organizational strategy, engineering detail, and hands-on implementation. You will independently lead ambiguous, cross-functional programs, translate business and regulatory needs into technical requirements, and build tooling that reduces manual work and improves delivery.

You will work closely with Engineering, Product, Quality, Legal, and Regulatory Affairs to integrate medical device requirements into development and operational workflows. A key focus will be using automation to improve requirements tracking, documentation, evidence collection, and readiness for regulatory reviews, audits, certifications, and product releases.

As a strategic partner to the Director of Operations, you will also support organizational planning, resource allocation, and executive decision-making. Success requires technical depth, sound judgment, and the ability to influence senior stakeholders while delivering measurable improvements across teams.

Responsibilities

What You’ll Do:

Lead Complex Technical Programs: Own cross-functional initiatives from problem definition through implementation. Establish technical requirements, milestones, dependencies, success measures, and accountability across Engineering, Product, Quality, Regulatory, and Operations.
Build Automation and Internal Tooling: Design, prototype, implement, and maintain scripts, integrations, dashboards, and workflow applications using Oracle APEX, Python, SQL, APIs, or comparable technologies. Streamline intake, approvals, reporting, and program execution.
Apply Codex and AI-Assisted Development: Use Codex and related tools to accelerate automation development, prototyping, testing, and documentation. Review and test generated outputs, applying appropriate controls when tooling supports regulated processes.
Connect Automation With Medical Device Compliance: Partner with Quality and Regulatory Affairs to identify opportunities to automate requirements tracking, traceability, evidence collection, change tracking, and readiness reporting. Ensure solutions support applicable documentation, review, and validation requirements.
Drive Medical Device Regulatory Readiness: Lead integrated plans supporting medical device certification, regulatory reviews, audits, and international expansion. Translate regulatory and quality requirements into actionable engineering and operational deliverables with clear ownership.
Strengthen Technical Documentation: Coordinate Engineering and Product teams to produce complete, consistent, and traceable documentation supporting development, verification and validation, risk management, and product launches.
Lead Release Readiness: Drive end-to-end release coordination, including engineering dependencies, quality and regulatory deliverables, readiness criteria, risk resolution, and stakeholder communication.
Partner With Operations Leadership: Serve as a strategic thought partner to the Director of Operations. Support OP1/OP2 planning, headcount and capacity planning, investment prioritization, and execution of organization-wide initiatives.
Turn Data Into Decisions: Build reliable reporting and analyze engineering, operational, and workforce data to identify bottlenecks, flag risks, and recommend actions. Measure improvements in cycle time, manual effort, delivery predictability, and compliance readiness.
Influence Across the Organization: Lead executive discussions, communicate technical tradeoffs clearly, and drive decisions across teams. Establish reusable tools and practices, mentor partners, and build trust while maintaining accountability.

What We’re Looking For

8+ years of relevant experience in technical program management, software engineering, systems engineering, or technical operations, including ownership of complex cross-functional programs.
Strong hands-on technical capabilities, with demonstrated experience building automation, internal applications, scripts, or systems integrations.
Practical experience with Codex or comparable AI-assisted coding tools, including reviewing, testing, and maintaining generated code.
Experience with technologies such as Oracle APEX, Python, SQL, REST APIs, version control, and CI/CD workflows.
Direct experience working on regulated medical device products, including software-based medical devices or software within medical device systems.
Working knowledge of medical device development and quality processes, including requirements traceability, design and development controls, risk management, verification and validation, and change control.
Experience translating regulatory and quality requirements into technical plans, operational workflows, and documented evidence.

jobs.title: Senior Technical Program Manager
jobs.description:
Job Description

Oracle Analytics sits at the intersection of enterprise data, cloud platforms, and applied AI. This role is for someone who wants to work at that intersection, helping customers understand and use Oracle AI Data Platform (AIDP), Fusion Data Intelligence (FDI), Oracle Analytics Cloud (OAC), Oracle Cloud Infrastructure (OCI), and related AI integrations in practical business workflows.

You'll join the Service Excellence team within Oracle Analytics and help create technical education that helps customers and field teams implement Oracle's analytics, data platform, and AI capabilities. This is a hands-on technical enablement role: you will learn product capabilities, build practical examples, teach customers, and work closely with product and technical experts.

Why this role is interesting

You will work near the forefront of analytics, data platforms, and applied AI.
You will get hands-on with Oracle’s analytics, data platform, and cloud technologies, then turn what you learn into practical education for customers, partners, and field teams.
You will build real enablement assets—demos, labs, videos, blogs, tutorials, and workshops—that help people apply technology to real business and data challenges.
You will collaborate with product managers, product marketing, user assistance/documentation teams, instructional designers, internal consulting specialists, and technical SMEs.

What You Will Do

Create and maintain technical enablement for customers, field teams, and implementation partners, translating product capabilities into clear, actionable education.
Build practical demos, instructional scenarios, technical labs, demo scripts, exercises, written tutorials, blogs, and supporting materials.
Deliver technical training to customers in live online sessions and in-person workshops; handle audience questions with accuracy, clarity, and appropriate follow-up.
Record concise explainer and tutorial videos for on-demand education.
Partner with product, documentation, instructional design, production, product marketing, internal consulting, and SME teams to plan, review, and publish enablement content.
Manage assigned workstreams with clear plans, milestones, dependencies, risks, owners, status updates, and follow-through appropriate for an IC3 Technical Program Manager.
Represent enablement needs to product and technical teams where documentation, demos, environments, or product clarity affect customer learning.

Responsibilities

What we are looking for

The successful candidate should understand how customers are applying AI capabilities—including chat-based interfaces, coding assistants, workflow automation, agents, and AI-assisted analytics—to solve business problems. They should be comfortable using AI tools to improve their own productivity and able to translate emerging AI, data platform, and analytics capabilities into practical education for customers and implementers.

The best candidate will be technically curious, customer-aware, detail-oriented, and interested in growing a career in Oracle Cloud, analytics, data platform, AI, and technical enablement.

Must have

Strong technical fundamentals and the ability to learn new technologies quickly.
Experience teaching or explaining technology to professional audiences through live instruction, written content, demonstrations, labs, or videos.
Excellent professional written and verbal English communication skills, including the ability to create and deliver clear technical education to global audiences.
Working understanding of AI fundamentals, including models, prompts, agents, automation patterns, and responsible AI practices.
Working knowledge of analytics and data platform concepts, including data warehousing, semantic modeling, dashboards, ETL/ELT, data pipelines, and lakehouse patterns.
Oracle Cloud or comparable cloud experience, with an understanding of how cloud services fit into customer workflows.
Ability to independently manage assigned workstreams, including planning, stakeholder coordination, status communication, dependency and risk management, and follow-through.
Ability to travel for in-person workshops, team collaboration, or content recording sessions.
5+ years of professional experience in technical enablement, cloud technology, analytics, data platforms, software development, data engineering, or related technical roles.

Preferred Experience

Hands-on experience with OCI, Oracle Analytics Cloud, Fusion Data Intelligence, Oracle AI Data Platform, Autonomous Database/Data Warehouse, data integration, or related Oracle data and analytics services.
Experience processing data with Apache Spark, or a strong data engineering background that would support quickly developing hands-on Spark expertise for Oracle AI Data Platform.
Experience working with product managers, product marketing, documentation/user assistance teams, instructional designers, production teams, technical reviewers, or subject matter experts.
Bachelor’s degree in computer science, information systems, data analytics, cloud technology, engineering, or a related technical field—or equivalent practical experience

The Opportunity

Client is seeking a high-impact Finance Program Manager to drive our Quote to Cash (Q2C) transformation , spanning deal structuring and pricing, order management, billing, revenue recognition, and collections. This role sits at the intersection of delivery leadership and operational excellence, with the opportunity to help redesign the processes and systems that power how Client quotes, contracts, invoices, and collects from customers at scale.

Own the delivery of Quote to Cash transformation initiative planning and design, including scope definition across pricing/CPQ, order management, billing, revenue recognition, and collections workstreams, deliverables tracking, and definition and measurement of success criteria (e.g., quote cycle time, billing accuracy, DSO).

Enable organizational learning and capability building through identification and codification of Q2C process patterns, frameworks, and best practices across quoting, contracting, billing, and cash application
Help design the future-state Quote to Cash operating model for Finance that will serve as an operational mechanism to drive transformation across Finance and its cross-functional stakeholders

EXPERIENCE:

Program/Portfolio Manager or Project Lead-equivalent experience; alternatively, 6-8+ years in a high-impact internal Quote to Cash, finance transformation, or revenue operations role at a leading global company.
Demonstrated track record of leading complex, multi-stakeholder transformations from problem definition through implementation – with clear accountability for business outcomes
Strong communication and people management skills, with the ability to drive impact through influence and to lead senior leaders through defined narratives/storyboards
Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, including translating data into actionable insights.

We are hiring a Project Manager - Engineering, Procurement & Construction (EPC)
with at least 10 years of experience to join our Upstream Construction Team. This role reports directly to the Director of Engineering, Procurement & Construction (EPC) and is responsible for managing subcontractors performing commercial and industrial construction and engineering projects nationwide.

The ideal candidate will have strong experience with process plant and process piping projects in the oil & gas, refinery, chemical process, biogas, or other related process facility sectors. The Project Manager will oversee projects during development, pre-construction, construction, and commissioning phases, with a focus on safety, budget, schedule, and risk management.

Responsibilities

Manage assigned projects through all phases: development, pre-construction, construction, and commissioning.

Oversee a mix of project types, including biogas-to-RNG conversion, biogas-to-renewable electricity projects, greenfield development, brownfield redevelopment, and distressed asset rehabilitation using EPC or design-build delivery methods.
Oversee or directly perform key activities such as owner permitting, contracting with consultants and contractors, negotiations and contractual agreements, utility interconnections (natural gas, power, water, sanitary, internet, etc.), land or land rights acquisition, estimating, bidding, equipment procurement, logistics, and material transport.
Ensure compliance with permits, material contracts, lenders, and equity partners, including required reporting.
Manage project costs, schedules, risks, deliverables, tasks, and regular reporting.

Qualifications

Bachelor’s degree (BS) in Electrical, Mechanical, Chemical, or Petroleum Engineering from an ABET-accredited university. Advanced degree (MS or MBA) preferred.
PMP certification preferred but not required.
Minimum 10 years of industrial-scale project management experience.
Demonstrated experience working on gas processing projects such as RNG, gas transmission and compression, gas treating, air separation, LNG, CNG, hydrogen, or related facilities.
Proven ability to adapt and pivot quickly in response to daily changes and project challenges.
Strong working knowledge of project management software such as Autodesk Construction Cloud, Procore, Primavera, or MS Project.
Solid understanding of project controls and contract management.
Experience managing projects with CAPEX greater than $50MM.
Ability to successfully manage concurrent projects across multiple states.
Excellent communication and negotiation skills.
Existing network of vendors, consultants, and contractors across the United States is highly preferred.
Must have relevant project experience within the United States.

new_jobs.description:
About OnePay

OnePay is the consumer fintech trusted by millions of Americans to make money better.

Our financial system is broken. High fees, low rates, and too few ways to actually grow your money. We’re fixing it. And we’re moving fast.

We’re an all-in-one financial services platform that brings together banking, high-yield savings, credit cards, point-of-sale lending, investing, and crypto in one place. We also partner with employers, HCM providers, gig platforms, and others to deliver embedded financial services to millions of employees and frontline workers.

We’re backed by Walmart, the world’s largest retailer, and Ribbit Capital, one of fintech’s most respected investors, giving us rare scale, distribution, and the opportunity to build something truly category-defining.

But What Really Sets OnePay Apart Is How We Move. Our Customers Don’t Have Time To Wait… And Neither Do We. This Place Moves Fast, And We’re Looking For People Who Are

Ready to run
Hungry and driven by urgency
Exceptional at what they do, with low ego
Comfortable operating in motion

The Role

Our growth stack has a lot of moving parts. The app and the website send events through a customer data platform to the ad platforms, our mobile measurement partners and the data warehouse. Most launches touch several of those systems and a few different teams.

You'll own the growth roadmap and work day to day with the MarTech and growth engineers who build and maintain all of this. Your job is to keep launches moving, make sure they get properly tested, and make sure the numbers on the other side can be trusted.

What You'll Do

Own the growth roadmap. Turn requests from marketing, paid media and product into scoped tickets with clear owners and dates. Keep the roadmap, runbooks and data flow docs current, and automate the repetitive parts with scripts or AI tools.
Lead testing and QA with the MarTech and growth engineers. Write test plans, check changes in staging and on test devices before they ship, and confirm they worked after launch.
Keep data flowing into paid media. Manage customer data platform destinations, audience syncs, reverse ETL and server-side events. Watch for dropped events, low match rates and schema drift, and write or tweak simple scripts when a setting isn't enough.
Own our relationship with the mobile measurement partners. Debug attribution problems, keep SDK and ad network integrations healthy, and handle support escalations, renewals and roadmap requests.
Keep tracking specs consistent across the app, the website, the customer data platform and web analytics, and dig in when numbers from different sources don't match.
Run SDK upgrades, attribution migrations and new vendor onboarding from evaluation through cutover, with a rollback plan.
Support paid and acquisition work across search, social, app-install networks, app store search ads and affiliates, including click ID plumbing, exclusion lists and test setup.
Bring Privacy and Legal in early, so consent, data-sharing limits and data subject requests are part of the plan and not a surprise at launch.

You Bring

8+ years in technical program management, supporting growth, performance marketing, martech or data teams.
Hands-on time with a customer data platform. You've connected it to several ad platforms, mapped and filtered events, and synced audiences with consent rules applied. You can read a tracking plan or a destination config and spot where a launch will break.
Experience with a mobile measurement partner and a good grasp of attribution: click IDs, ATT and SKAdNetwork, view-through versus click-through, and platform-reported versus first-party conversions. You've debugged discrepancies and dealt with the vendor directly.
Experience doing testing and QA with engineers on tracking or integration launches: test plans, staging checks, debug tools, test devices, and regression checks after SDK or release changes.
You write SQL and pull your own numbers.
A track record of running programs across engineering, design, data and marketing, with clear specs, honest status updates and a written record of decisions.
Good judgment on priorities, and comfort saying no. You're fine with ambiguity and with working asynchronously on a remote-first team.

Nice to Have

Experience at a consumer fintech or another regulated company.
Reverse ETL into paid media (conversion APIs, offline conversions, audience uploads) and keeping it healthy: match rates, deduplication, delays and dropped events.
Reading and writing simple scripts in JavaScript or Liquid, for example to transform an event payload or build a template.
Experience with a cloud data warehouse.
A working understanding of marketing privacy rules: consent, CCPA and similar state laws, GLBA, and limits on sharing customer data with ad platforms. You know when to ask Legal.

What We Offer

Competitive base salary, stock options, and health benefits from Day 1
401(k) plan with company match
Remote-friendly (US), flexible time off (FTO), and opportunities for growth
A high-growth, mission-driven, inclusive culture where your work has real impact

with an expectation to be in the office 2–3 days per week. Candidates must be based in the NYC or San Francisco metro area or able to relocate independently within 90 days of their start date. Occasional travel will be required for team on-sites.

What You’ll Do

Lead programs from planning through launch, defining milestones, owners, dependencies, risks, and decisions.
Coordinate Product, Engineering, Data, Operations, Support, Partnerships, and other customer-facing teams to deliver on commitments.
Lead responses to urgent issues by establishing their scope, assigning owners, agreeing on next steps and timelines, and keeping stakeholders informed.
Serve as a trusted R&D point of contact for key customers and partner with customer-facing teams to understand and address their needs.
Work with Product and Engineering to identify recurring experience issues, deliver immediate fixes, and prioritize lasting improvements.
Build practical, repeatable ways to triage issues, prioritize work, manage escalations, track risks, and share progress.
Prepare teams for launches and changes by confirming responsibilities, dependencies, risks, testing, and operational readiness.
Develop an operating model that supports a growing portfolio of global, payer, and partner relationships.

What Success Looks Like

Core member experiences across web, mobile, and other touchpoints are regularly audited and proactively monitored against member and customer needs.
Every priority program has a clear delivery plan that accounts for dependencies and improves predictability and time to launch.
Complex programs meet agreed commitments. Scope changes and trade-offs are surfaced early, documented, and resolved with the right stakeholders.
Leaders across Engineering, Product, Customer Success, and Marketing have clear, timely information about progress, risks, and decisions.
Program measures, such as on-time delivery, cycle time, scope stability, defect escape rate, and launch readiness, are defined and improve over time.
Payer programs receive thorough QA and regression testing, supported by a plan to scale those practices as the portfolio grows.
Teams spend less time navigating unclear processes and more time resolving customer needs and delivering work.
Customers and the Payer team feel well supported, especially when issues are urgent or complex.

As a Project Manager, you will work closely with consultants, technical specialists, building owners, architects, developers, contractors, and facility managers to deliver consulting, design, inspection, certification, and project management services. You'll oversee multiple projects simultaneously while serving as a key point of contact for clients and project stakeholders, helping ensure projects are delivered on time, within budget, and to the highest quality standards.

This position is ideal for professionals who enjoy a combination of technical problem-solving, client interaction, project management, construction coordination, and consulting within the architecture, engineering, and construction industry.

About Lerch Bates

Lerch Bates (LB) is a global technical consulting firm focused on improving how buildings perform for owners, designers, and the people who use them every day. For more than 75 years we’ve partnered on some of the world’s most complex and high-profile projects. Today we provide Total Building Performance expertise that integrates Building Science and Building Flow into a unified delivery model.

Our work spans design, construction, investigation, repair, rehabilitation, management, and modernization with one consistent goal: helping clients make confident, well-informed decisions in an increasingly complex built environment.

We are 100% employee-owned through our ESOP. That means when the company succeeds, our employee-owners share in that success. It's more than a retirement benefit—it's an ownership mindset backed by the opportunity to build long-term financial value while helping shape the future of the company.

What You’ll Do

The duties listed below are intended only as illustrations of the various types of work that may be performed in this position. They are not intended to prescribe or restrict the assignments that management may make.

Project Management & Client Support

Manage multiple façade access and building maintenance equipment projects through all phases of the project lifecycle.
Coordinate project scope, schedules, deliverables, budgets, and client communication.
Lead or participate in project meetings with clients, architects, contractors, consultants, and project stakeholders.
Proactively communicate project status, risks, recommendations, and schedule updates.

Support business development efforts and contribute to the continued growth of the Façade Access Group.

Technical Consulting & Design

Prepare specifications, calculations, design documents, and technical information packages.
Research, interpret, and apply applicable industry codes, standards, regulations, and best practices.
Collaborate with internal consultants, technicians, and project teams to develop practical and effective solutions.

Field Services & Quality Assurance

Conduct site surveys, inspections, and field observations.
Perform quality assurance reviews to verify conformance with contract documents, manufacturer requirements, industry standards, and project objectives.
Document observations, deficiencies, and recommendations through clear and accurate reporting.
Support certification, inspection, repair, maintenance, and installation-related projects.
Travel periodically to project sites across the United States as required.

Project Financial Management

Manage project financial performance with support from Project Coordinators and Project Analysts.
Assist with project setup, forecasting, invoicing, budgeting, and closeout documentation.
Monitor project progress against scope, schedule, and budget objectives.
Help maintain profitability and operational efficiency while delivering exceptional client service.

What You’ll Bring

Bachelor's degree in Construction Management, Architecture, Engineering, or a related field preferred.
Alternatively, 10+ years of project management experience in the construction industry may be considered in lieu of a degree.
1-3+ years of experience within architecture, engineering, construction, consulting, building maintenance equipment, façade access, building envelope, or a related industry.
Strong project management skills with the ability to manage multiple priorities and deadlines simultaneously.
Ability to communicate complex technical information through written reports, presentations, and client discussions.
Excellent technical writing, documentation, and organizational skills.
Strong problem-solving and analytical abilities with the capacity to develop practical solutions.
Ability to work independently while contributing to a collaborative team environment.
Demonstrated commitment to quality, consistency, accuracy, and attention to detail.
Strong interpersonal skills and the ability to build relationships with clients, contractors, consultants, and team members.
Working knowledge of construction documents, design drawings, and technical specifications.
Ability to adapt to changing project requirements and business priorities.
Strong proficiency with Microsoft Office and other project-related software tools.
Willingness to travel domestically as needed to support project and client requirements.

Preferred Qualifications

Experience with façade access systems, building maintenance units (BMUs), suspended access systems, davits, roof anchors, fall protection, or related building access equipment.
Experience preparing technical reports, drawings, specifications, or construction documentation.
Knowledge of applicable OSHA regulations, industry standards, and façade access requirements.
Experience coordinating design, construction, inspection, or certification projects.
Exposure to consulting environments and client-facing project management responsibilities.

Why Work with Lerch Bates?

Competitive base salary of $75,000 - $95,000 per year, based on experience, qualifications, and location
Annual performance-based bonus opportunity, with target incentive levels varying by position and based on individual and company performance.
100% Employee-Owned ESOP (company-funded retirement benefit that allows eligible employees to share in the company's long-term success)
Health, dental, and vision insurance
Paid time off (starting at 17 days annually)
10 paid holidays
401(k) with 6% employer match
Paid parental leave
Professional development and tuition reimbursement
Employee assistance and wellness programs

Become an Employee-Owner

One of the biggest advantages of working at Lerch Bates is that we are 100% employee-owned through our Employee Stock Ownership Plan (ESOP).

Unlike many companies that offer only a salary and retirement plan, eligible employees receive company-funded ESOP shares at no cost to them as part of their long-term retirement benefits.

As Lerch Bates grows, employee-owners share in the company's success. For many employees, the ESOP becomes one of the most valuable financial benefits of their career by helping build meaningful long-term wealth in addition to their salary and traditional 401(k).

When you join Lerch Bates, you are not just building better buildings. You also have the opportunity to build your financial future alongside the company's success.

Core Values

Ownership

Community
Integrity
Respect
Optimism

Working Environment

This position is performed in a combination of office, client, and field environments. Work regularly takes place in occupied buildings, active construction sites, mechanical rooms, elevator machine rooms, elevator pits, hoistways, and other vertical transportation spaces.

Travel throughout the assigned service area is required.

Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable qualified individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions of the position.

We are looking for a Project Manager to join our Operations team and support the delivery of strategic initiatives across ActiveViam. We are also developing how we use AI and automation within project and programme management. A key part of the role will be looking for opportunities to reduce manual administration, improve the quality of project information and make better use of the systems and data we already have. AI and continuous improvement

Use AI tools to support project administration, analysis and reporting.
Identify manual activities that could be simplified or automated.
Help test and implement AI-enabled project management workflows.
Work with colleagues across the business to understand how existing AI capabilities could improve project and programme delivery.
Support the development of repeatable processes and templates that can be used across strategic initiatives.
Look for opportunities to improve project management discipline without introducing unnecessary process or bureaucracy.

Essential Skills And Experience

3–5 year’s experience in project management, programme support, PMO, business analysis or a similar role.
Practical experience working in a technology, fintech, financial services or related environment.
Hands-on experience using Jira and Confluence to manage project or product delivery.
A recognised project management qualification or certification, such as PRINCE2, APM, AgilePM, Scrum or equivalent.
Good understanding of core project management disciplines, including planning, milestones, dependencies, risks, issues and change.
Experience coordinating activity across multiple teams and stakeholders.
Ability to take complex or incomplete information and structure it clearly.
Strong written and verbal communication skills.
Confidence following up on commitments and working with people at different levels of an organisation.
Good analytical and problem-solving skills.
Strong attention to detail while retaining sight of the overall objective.
An active interest in AI and how it can be applied to improve ways of working.
A willingness to learn and develop knowledge of ActiveViam’s products, clients and markets.

Would be an advantage

Experience working within fintech, capital markets, investment management, risk management or financial technology.
Familiarity with financial services products, investment workflows or risk concepts.
Experience supporting Product and Engineering teams and working with software development lifecycles.
Experience working within Agile delivery environments.

The person

Who We Are

Notion is the collaborative AI workspace where teams and agents think together. We're building one place where your knowledge, projects, meetings, and AI tools live side by side, so work is faster, clearer, and less fragmented. Millions of individuals, small teams, and large companies run their work on Notion.

Notinos (our employees) are customer zero in bringing this future of work to life. We care about craft, building things that last, and the belief that great work is still fundamentally human. Our goal isn’t to ship the next feature. Each and every team of Notinos is working to set the standard for how humans work together in the AI era. From building a business’s system of record to making and managing AI agents to automating away the busy work, we care deeply about giving our customers more time for their life’s work.

About The Role

Notion is looking for a Recruiting Program Manager to help design, build, and scale the systems and programs that power how we hire. This is a role for someone who moves fast, takes ownership, and doesn't wait to be told what to do — someone who operates with both strategic altitude and operational precision, and knows how to bring clarity and momentum to complex cross-functional work.

We're at an inflection point in how we think about recruiting at Notion, and this role sits at the center of it. You'll partner closely with Recruiters, Recruiting Operations, People Operations, and senior leadership to drive some of our highest-priority initiatives — building the programs and processes that define how Notion finds, evaluates, and brings in exceptional talent.

This role can be based in either San Francisco or New York City. We work from our offices on Mondays, Tuesdays and Thursdays (our Anchor Days) because we do our best thinking and building together in person. We’re looking for someone who’s excited to work alongside the team during those days.

What You'll Achieve

The scope of this role will evolve with the team's highest priorities. Some examples of what you might work on:

Interviewer systems and efficacy — design the systems, structures, and standards that make Notion's interviewing reliably great: how we train interviewers, how we measure their effectiveness, how we calibrate quality over time, and how we continuously raise the bar; this includes programs like Interviewer 101, Hiring Manager Training, and functional interviewer certifications tailored to specific teams
Interviewer pool health — own the systems and strategy behind how we maintain a healthy, well-mapped interviewer pool, manage AI and experimental interview formats, and keep quality high at scale
Recruiting team onboarding and enablement — build and run programs that get new recruiters up to speed quickly and keep the team operating at a high level

Cross-functional playbooks and infrastructure — build the processes, communications, and coordination frameworks that help Recruiting run with more consistency, clarity, and scale

5+ years of relevant experience in program management, recruiting operations, or a highly cross-functional role in a fast-moving environment
High agency — you move fast, take ownership end-to-end, and don't wait for perfect information or explicit direction to get started. Ambiguity doesn't scare you.
Builder mentality — you're most energized when creating something new or improving something that doesn't yet work well
Strong AI skills — think beyond generative AI. We're looking for folks with hands-on experience building custom agents, skills, etc and have taught them to others. You're genuinely excited about using AI to change how a core business function works
Strong project management skills — you can lead complex initiatives from scoping through execution, managing stakeholders, timelines, and competing priorities along the way; you're equally comfortable driving short-term sprints and stewarding long-range programs that evolve over months or years
Proven ability to operate with discretion and high judgment on sensitive or high-profile work
Strong analytical instincts — you use data to evaluate program health, spot patterns, and make informed decisions
Outstanding written and verbal communication — you tailor your message to the audience and create clarity across all levels of the organization

Nice to Haves

Experience with recruiting program management workstreams through different stages of recruiting evolution
You use Notion and love it — you get what we're building

For some roles, AI fluency is a core requirement — when that’s the case, we'll say so explicitly in the qualifications. People who thrive here don’t treat AI as a novelty. Our more than 22,000 employees are committed to relentlessly enhancing the fan experience and delighting sports fans globally.

About The Role

At Fanatics Core, we build the secure, scalable platform that powers sports fans everywhere. As we grow into new international markets, we need a senior technical leader to turn our expansion strategy into launches that happen on time and stay compliant.

As Senior Staff TPM for International Expansion, you’ll own the technical program for taking Fanatics Core into new markets around the world. You’ll work with senior leaders across Engineering, Product, Legal, Compliance, Finance and Operations, and with external vendors and regulators. Together you’ll work out what each market requires, design a repeatable launch playbook, and run the cross-functional effort to deliver it. You’ll make sure our platform can handle the regulatory, data, payments and localization needs of every region we enter.

What You’ll Do

Own the international launch program from start to finish. Lead market launches from early assessment through go-live and stabilization. Set the scope, milestones, dependencies and success criteria for each market.
Turn regulation into engineering requirements. Work with Legal and Compliance to convert market-specific rules into clear technical requirements. These include licensing, geolocation, data residency, privacy (e.g., GDPR), KYC/AML, responsible gaming and audit/reporting.
Build a repeatable expansion playbook. Design a scalable model for market entry, with reusable architecture patterns, configuration-driven market setup and standard launch-readiness checklists, so each launch gets faster and cheaper than the last.
Manage vendors and third-party integrations. Run technical delivery with external partners such as payment providers, identity verification, geolocation, content/data feeds and local hosting. Hold them to timelines, SLAs and compliance obligations.
Drive platform readiness. Partner with Core Engineering on the shared platform capabilities expansion needs: multi-region infrastructure, multi-currency and multi-language support, regional payments, tax and reporting.
Ensure launch quality and operational readiness. Set up go-live criteria, cutover plans, hypercare and post-launch reviews, so new markets launch reliably and meet regulatory uptime and reporting requirements.
Align senior stakeholders. Build strong relationships inside and outside Engineering. Communicate clearly with executives on status, risks, trade-offs and decisions across multiple concurrent market programs.
Lead with data. Define and report on the KPIs that measure expansion progress and health, such as time-to-market, launch readiness, compliance findings and post-launch stability.
Raise the bar on program management. Mentor other TPMs and help strengthen planning, delivery and governance practices across the organization.

Basic Qualifications

10+ years of technical program management experience, including leading large, cross-functional programs at a senior/staff level
12+ years working directly with software engineering teams on complex, distributed systems
Proven track record launching products or platforms in multiple international markets, ideally in regulated industries
Experience translating regulatory and compliance requirements into technical delivery plans
Experience managing external vendors and third-party technical integrations

Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to influence executives and explain complex technical and regulatory issues to non-technical audiences
Experience running programs with tools such as Jira and Confluence across multiple SDLC methodologies

Overview

At Credence, we support our clients' mission-critical needs, powered by technology. We provide cutting-edge solutions, including AI/ML, enterprise modernization, and advanced intelligence capabilities, to the largest defense and health federal organizations. Through partnership and trust, we increase mission success for war-fighters and secure our nation for a better future. 
We are privately held, are repeatedly recognized as a top place to work, and have been on the Inc. 5000 Fastest Growing Private Companies list for the last 12 years. We practice servant leadership and believe that by focusing on the success of our clients, team members, and partners, we all achieve greater success. 
Credence has an immediate opening for a Senior Program Manager who will be primarily responsible for supporting the Air Force Life Cycle Management Center WAM (AFLCMC/WAM) directorate, F-16 division at WPAFB, OH. 
F-16 "Viper" AFLCMC/WAM is headquartered at Hill Air Force Base with units located at Wright-Patterson Air Force Base, Tyndall Air Force Base, Eglin Air Force Base, and Davis-Monthan Air Force Base.  The F-16 "Viper" is a multi-role fighter jet delivering air-to-air, air-to-ground, and surveillance capabilities for the United States Air Force (USAF) and Coalition Partners.
The F-16 program has the largest Foreign Military Sales (FMS) program in U.S. history producing over 4,500 jets for 24 countries.  Each F-16 FMS case is uniquely tailored to country requirements / development / funding.  Presently, FMS production orders exist through 2030. Additionally, the F-16 program includes the Multi-National Fighter Program (MNFP). MNFP is not a typical FMS program, but a unique, cooperative USAF and development program implemented through the FMS process under the framework of a Memorandum of Understanding (MOU). MNFP began in 1975 with the countries of Belgium, Denmark, the Netherlands, and Norway; Portugal joined in 2000.

Responsibilities include, but are not limited to the duties listed below

Assist in risk management, cost, schedule, and performance of various software development efforts in a program management role, and report on them monthly through use of the Project Management Resource Tool (PMRT). 
Assist to interpret, organize, execute and coordinate assignments within the context of the Government acquisition process. 
Assist to explore software development and integration, definition of scope, and selection of problems for investigation. 
Support the program director at executive levels within the Government and other Contractor organizations, including major program reviews, inspections, conferences, and other program evaluations and major milestone events. 
Assist to establish and maintain contacts between the program office, supporting Government offices, other Contractors, and higher headquarters' mid-to upper-level staff. 
Assist with the analysis of war fighter requirements with ACC and serve as key advisor to F-16 Division leadership on mission-critical capability trades. 
Support war fighter Urgent Operational Needs (UONs), and support UON execution teams through recommendation of accelerated test concepts, minimum levels of integration required to satisfy operational need, and trade-offs among risk, schedule, performance, and cost. 
Support the OFP software development and testing processes, interpreting user requirements, and possesses a thorough understanding of the MNFP cost-sharing process. 
Assist with strategic planning, program planning, systems integration, weapons integration, requirements assessment, and program evaluations. 
Assist to apply integration, communication, coordination, organizational, and planning expertise to technical and acquisition efforts across multiple F-16 integration activities. 
Support Technical Interchange Meetings (TIMs) and working groups, serving as a liaison between user requirements and organic engineering activity. 
Assist to develop concise, coherent program status briefings to senior staff.
Support the chief engineer in investigation and resolution of fielded program deficiencies, to include support of Crisis Management Teams (CMTs). 
Support and conduct studies and analysis of tradeoffs for incorporation of potential capabilities in future USAF OFP software. 
 Advise and assist the Government with complex program management tasks, coordinating and managing multiple contracts, and identifying and confirming the annual funding requirements for those contracts
Assist with project cost estimates and have knowledge of the system engineering process and project Configuration Management (CM) requirements.
Assist to investigate, analyze, plan, design, develop, implement, and evaluate solutions for project / program efforts; provide expert-level issue resolution and recommendation support to achieve desired program outcomes to situations that may include, but not be limited to, the following functional areas: program management, logistics, maintenance, supply, financial management (FM), test, security management, information management, and contracting.
Support efforts including, but not limited to, strategic planning, program planning, systems integration, weapons integration, requirements assessment, and program evaluations
Assist to apply broad user war fighter requirements and applying solutions through the acquisition process
Define requirements with ACC and serve as key advisor to System Program Office (SPO) leadership on mission critical capability trades.
Support programs in an international environment, including support to implement the requirements of foreign governments
Support development and test activities required to support warfighter UON
Suppport UON execution teams by recommending accelerated test concepts, minimum levels of integration required to satisfy operational need, and trade-offs among risk, schedule, performance, and cost
Assist with interpreting user requirements, to implement the MNFP cost sharing process. 
Assist with management of risk, cost, schedule, and performance of various OFP software development efforts
Assist with integration, communication, coordination, organizational, and planning support to technical and acquisition processes across multiple F-16 integration activities
Support F-16 avionics and weapons capabilities; complex weapon(s) integration; aircraft operations and employment; development of F-16 PVI; OFP software requirements development; development processes under the MNFP; aircraft mission and support equipment; authorized aircraft configurations and capabilities; aircraft subsystems; systems integration; advanced sensor integration
Coordinate the upgrade identification and requirements development process for new USAF hardware integration and software development programs. The Contractor shall complete program technical assessments and assist with developing cost estimates in support of the integration and software-development programs.  The Contractor shall support Government/Contractor work-share agreements between LM Aero to organic software development at OO-ALC, for development efforts and support complex subsystem integration/coordination for advanced sensors, weapons, and electronic warfare equipment
Support the transition and stand-up of an organic software development capability for F-16 to assess and coordinate unique requirements and funding timelines
 Assist with management of test execution, integration and sustainment support of various software upgrades such as the Automatic Ground Collision Avoidance System (AGCAS) integration in current OFP software. 
Support the Avionics System Requirements Review Conference (ASRRC) and Cockpit Review Team (CRT) process for initial requirements definition, and Pilot Vehicle Interface (PVI) development to support HQ ACC initiatives
Assist with bridging process between acquisition and user communities such as military fighter/bomber pilots, navigators, weapons systems officers, and software development
Support studies and analysis of tradeoffs for incorporation of potential capabilities in future F-16 USAF or FMS software
Manage the software supporting AESA radar design try-out activities for radar risk reduction
Support and conduct preparations and review pertinent data, coordinate with applicable managers, and finalize related documentation/information for verbal presentation of the plan status at required meetings.  Meetings may include but are not limited to IPT meetings, Program Management Reviews (PMRs), TIMs, and other required conferences
Assist in the preparation of concise, coherent program status briefing charts to support meetings with senior staff
Support the F-16 Chief Engineer in investigation and resolution of fielded program deficiencies, to include support of CMT
Serve as lead technical advisor to the materiel leader for the F-16, supporting senior leader efforts in identifying cost efficiencies for aircraft trainer/simulator programs

Requirements

Clearance: Secret
Master's in a related field and a minimum of 10 ten years of experience in the respective technical / professional discipline being performed, at least five of which must be in the DoD or
Bachelor's Degree in a related field and a minimum of 12 years of experience in the respective technical/professional discipline being performed, five of which must be in the DoD or

Senior leader-level experience at the HQ USAF or HQ ACC level
Ten years of experience in understanding user requirements, test planning, management, certification, and evaluation

new_jobs.title: Senior Technical Program Manager, Partner Trip Platform
new_jobs.description:
Waymo is an autonomous driving technology company with the mission to be the world's most trusted driver. Since its start as the Google Self-Driving Car Project in 2009, Waymo has focused on building the Waymo Driver—The World's Most Experienced Driver™—to improve access to mobility while saving thousands of lives now lost to traffic crashes. The Waymo Driver powers Waymo’s fully autonomous ride-hail service and can also be applied to a range of vehicle platforms and product use cases. The Waymo Driver has provided over ten million rider-only trips, enabled by its experience autonomously driving over 100 million miles on public roads and tens of billions in simulation across 15+ U.S. states.

Waymo’s Technical Program Managers and Program Managers are accountable for Waymo’s roadmap execution by providing thoughtful cross-functional planning, clarity, and proactive risk management. In the face of complex technical and operational challenges with no established playbooks to follow, we act with thoughtful urgency, driving conversations, discussions, and outcomes. Our team partners closely with every function of Waymo to structure, own and drive work towards real-world deployments of the Waymo Driver across platforms and geographies.

You Will

Lead cross-functional technical programs to integrate Waymo's autonomous service with third-party platforms.
Own the technical delivery of external integrations end-to-end, from creating the cross-functional execution plan to defining the process for ensuring continued quality post-launch.
Serve as the primary execution counterpart for external teams, translating an ambiguous set of work into clearly defined deliverables, owners, and schedule.
Drive technical trade-off decisions across scope, schedule, scalability, and user experience.
Proactively identify, prioritize, and mitigate risks and dependencies across multiple concurrent partner programs, and represent them to executive leadership.
Build the scalable frameworks, processes, and tooling that let Waymo onboard and operate many partner integrations without a linear increase in effort.

You Have

7+ years of experience leading highly complex, cross-functional technical programs with a holistic understanding of business-wide functions (e.g. Product, Engineering, Business Development, Operations).
A track record of shipping consumer-facing software products and features, with demonstrated ownership of the execution from kickoff through launch and post-launch operations.
Experience running programs where critical dependencies sit with teams outside your direct influence, and a track record of getting them to deliver.
Strong technical depth: you can read a system design, hold your own in architecture and API discussions with engineers, and tease out the scope, schedule, and risk implications of each option to drive the decision.
Deep care for the end user, with the ability to keep rider experience and quality at the center of technically complex, multi-party programs.
Exceptional communication and leadership skills, with demonstrated ability to align diverse internal teams and external partners and influence executive stakeholders.

We Prefer

Experience with external-facing integrations, platform APIs, or B2B2C products where another company's engineering team was a critical dependency.
Experience in rideshare, mobility, delivery, two-sided marketplaces, or other products where software coordinates physical operations in real time.
Experience launching products or integrations in multiple geographies, including navigating localization, payments, and regulatory requirements.
Familiarity with defining quality gates, testing plans, SLAs, and launch readiness processes for systems shared with external teams.

Travel Requirements

Occasional travel for partner working sessions or market launches

new_jobs.title: Technical Program Manager - Pharmacy Care
new_jobs.description:
The Technical Program Manager, Pharmacy Care owns the delivery of our largest and most complex pharmacy platform programs. This is a hands-on technical delivery role for someone who can hold a multi-party, multi-phase implementation together: integration dependencies across organizations, contractual milestones with defined acceptance criteria, regulated launch requirements, and a phased rollout that moves from a controlled pilot all the way through government-program populations.

You will be the connective tissue between Product, Engineering, Design, Solutions, Data, Security, Compliance, Client Services, Service Delivery, and external partners. The work is equal parts technical fluency and program discipline . Y ou need to be able to read an API specification, run the integration conversation on your own, and then convert what you heard into a plan, a dependency, or an escalation. If a date is going to move, you know first and you say so early.

This program delivers a pharmacy-first digital member experience: medic ine cabinet , claims and prior-authorization visibility, real-time price transparency, benefit and accumulator presentment, digital ID cards, document access, member notifications, an AI care assistant, and the partner integrations that power all of it.

What you'll do

Own the program end to end

Own delivery of a multi-phase, enterprise-scale platform implementation from mobilization and discovery through pilot, staged client rollout, and transition to ongoing operations.
Structure the program into workstreams with clear owners, milestones, and exit criteria.
Build and maintain the integrated program plan: scope, milestones, critical path, dependencies, acceptance criteria, and readiness gates across every workstream.
Sequence phased rollout waves : internal pilot, shared pilot clients, standard commercial rollout, strategic accounts, and regulated and government-program populations
Drive milestone attainment where milestones carry contractual acceptance criteria and commercial consequence . Know exactly what must be true for each gate to close.

Drive the technical integration

Coordinate delivery across the full integration surface: eligibility, identity and authentication, claims history, accumulators, formulary and medication data, real-time pricing, prior-authorization status and intake, document retrieval, event and webhook interfaces, notifications, and federated SSO connections.
Work with Engineering and Architecture on integration design, data mapping, identifier reconciliation across systems, environment strategy, and interface specifications covering authentication, schemas, idempotency, error handling, monitoring, and reconciliation.
Hold the line on data quality and interface readiness , real-time versus batch trade-offs, validation rigor, and what happens when bad data moves downstream fast.
Manage partner-side technical dependencies rigorously: API documentation and sandbox access, file specifications and cadence, test data and credentials, environment provisioning, technical SMEs, and approvals. Track them, age them, and escalate with evidence before they become schedule impacts.

Run governance and quality

Establish and run program governance: meeting cadence, status reporting, RAID log, decision records, RASCI ownership across organizations, and executive-level reporting that tells the truth concisely.
Own scope discipline. Distinguish clarification from expansion, route genuine change through a documented change-control process and protect the committed timeline.
Partner with QA and Engineering to maintain a live quality and release-readiness view : test coverage and execution, defect counts by severity and trend, automation and regression status, environment and test-data blockers, and an honest Green/Yellow/Red call.
Produce release readiness summaries ahead of each major milestone: included and deferred scope, test and UAT completion, open defects and mitigations, security, privacy, performance and accessibility results, residual risk, and a clear Go / Go-with-conditions / No-Go recommendation.
Run post-production validation after each go-live — smoke checks, incident and defect capture, corrective actions, and follow-through.

Carry the regulated-delivery load

Coordinate security and privacy readiness: penetration testing and vulnerability assessment evidence, HIPAA security and privacy review, remediation plans for critical and high findings, compensating controls, and formal sign-off gates.
Drive accessibility conformance, including testing evidence, remediation, and an exceptions process.
Manage government-program readiness : regulatory requirement schedules, program-specific accumulator presentment, required member documents, regulatory data-format transitions, and the phased commitments and approvals that go with them.
Ensure AI-enabled member functionality ships within approved governance: guardrails, escalation pathways, PHI handling, retention, auditability, and change-approval requirements.

Build the operating model

Coordinate a distributed delivery team spanning product, design, engineering in the US and Europe, solutions, data and analytics, service delivery, and go-to-market.
Stand up operational readiness ahead of scale: implementation playbooks, configuration and administrative tooling, documentation, train-the-trainer enablement, support and escalation model, and contact-center integration.
Define the reporting and analytics requirements the program is measured by : engagement and funnel data, feature utilization , communication delivery, and the extract or sync mechanics that deliver it.
Define and track program health metrics: milestone attainment, dependency aging, defect burndown, integration readiness, launch readiness, and post-launch stability.
Transition the program cleanly into ongoing governance and continuous delivery rather than leaving an implementation that nobody owns.

What we're looking for

Required

Bachelor's degree required ; a technical discipline or an advanced degree is a plus.
7+ years in technical program or project management, including ownership of enterprise-scale integration programs in healthcare or another regulated industry.
Demonstrated experience leading multi-party programs with external partners , delivered against defined milestones, dependencies, and acceptance criteria.
T echnical fluency. REST APIs, authentication and federated identity (SSO, SAML, OIDC), batch file interfaces, event and webhook architectures, data mapping, and schema validation. You can read a specification, run the technical conversation yourself, and hold both engineers and partners to what was agreed .
Hands-on experience with healthcare data domains : eligibility, claims, benefit accumulators, formulary and medication data, and prior authorization.
Experience delivering in a regulated environmen t: HIPAA and PHI handling, security revie w , privacy requirements, and accessibility obligations.
Proven ownership of quality and release readiness : test strategy, UAT coordination, defect triage, and the judgment to make a defensible go/no-go call.
Exceptional written communication. This role produces the artifacts other people make decisions from : plans, status, readiness summaries, escalations. They must be clear, accurate , and to the point .
Rigorous on scope and change control , and comfortable saying no with a reason and a path.
Comfortable in a fast-moving, evolving organization ; a ble to replan without losing the thread.

Preferred

Pharmacy or pharmacy benefits ecosystem experience : pharmacy claims, formulary, pricing and adjudication concepts, specialty and mail-order fulfillment, or related integrations.
Medicare or other government-program delivery experience, including CMS requirements, program-specific accumulator stages, required member communications, and regulatory format transitions.
Experience with multi-tenant platform delivery and client-by-client configuration at scale.

Who we are

Transcarent is the One Place for Health and Careᵀᴹ, bringing medical, pharmacy, and point solutions together with the WayFinding ᵀᴹ experience, the first and only generative AI-powered health and care platform for health consumers.

Our WayFinding experience, paired with transparent and consumer-driven pharmacy care, 2nd.MD expert medical opinions, and virtual primary care, works seamlessly with comprehensive Care Experiences — Cancer Care, Surgery Care, and Weight Health — to support people with all of their health needs, simple or serious. More than 1,700 employers and health plans rely on us to provide information, guidance, and care, empowering health consumers with more choice, an experience they love, access to higher-quality care, and lower costs for 21 million Members.

Our Values Guide Everything We Do

Results: We take ownership, solve with speed, and deliver for our people and each other

Total Rewards

Build the future, spark innovation and align your career with purpose.

McKinstry is innovating the waste and climate harm out of the built environment and creating lasting impact. Together, we’re building a thriving planet.

Buildings are a leading contributor to the climate crisis, generating nearly 40% of total global energy-related carbon emissions. We’re making a lasting impact on our industry and within our communities by addressing the climate, affordability and equity crises through:

renewables and energy services
engineering and design
construction and facility services

To get where we’re going, we need big thinkers, problem solvers and collaborative mindsets. Does that sound like you?

The Opportunity with McKinstry

McKinstry is looking for a Senior Program Manager, Standardization
to join our Offsite Manufacturing division in Seattle, WA
. The Senior Program Manager – Standardization leads the development, release, and adoption of the business processes that run the business unit and leads execution of the department's technology and business process improvement initiatives. The role's current top priority is leading implementation of Acumatica, the business unit's ERP system — building and maintaining the implementation schedule, providing status updates, and documenting the business process decisions made along the way — with the same playbook applied to future technology and process initiatives. Beyond named initiatives, the role focuses on business unit processes, especially those that cross functional boundaries where commercial, engineering, supply chain, operations, quality, project management, and finance must hand off work to one another. This role shapes how the business executes and drives development of documented, governed, repeatable standard work. Additional responsibilities may include:

Business Process Leadership

Own the process roadmap for the business unit, sequencing standardization work against live production commitments, growth targets, and customer program milestones.
Maintain the business unit’s process architecture: what processes exist, who owns each, how they connect, and where the gaps are.
Translate business objectives into standardization objectives and measures with leadership and report progress regularly.
Advise leaders on where standardization creates leverage and where flexibility should be intentionally preserved.
Initiative and Implementation Management
Lead the implementation of Acumatica (ERP), including building and maintaining the implementation schedule and providing regular status updates.
Apply the same implementation approach — schedule ownership, decision documentation, stakeholder alignment — to future technology and process improvement initiatives.
Organize and execute department business process improvement initiatives from scoping through completion.
Draft and propose OKRs for initiatives or execute against and report progress on OKRs set by leadership, depending on the initiative.
Source, select, and manage contractors and consultants supporting initiatives, owning scope, schedule, and budget for those engagements.

Cross-Functional Process Integration

Lead standardization of processes that span multiple functions, including order intake and contract-to-production handoff, engineering release and change control, procurement and long-lead material planning, production scheduling and capacity, quality and nonconformance, shipping and field integration, and warranty and closeout.
Define the inputs, outputs, ownership, and acceptance criteria at each functional handoff so work does not stall or degrade in the gaps between teams.
Resolve conflicting or duplicative practice between functions, escalating to leadership where process ownership is genuinely contested.
Embed processes into the systems of record – ERP, document control, quality management, and reporting – so process is reinforced by tooling rather than carried by individual experience.
Reconcile customer-specific commercial requirements with internal standard work so program obligations are met without one-off process.

Process Development and Release

Coordinate cross-functional teams through a standard development process to produce released, version-controlled deliverables.
Write and review policies, procedures, work instructions, and supporting documentation — including documenting the business process decisions made during initiative implementations — with process owners and subject matter experts.
Establish document control, revision, and approval conventions so processes are governed.

Change Management, Training, and Adoption

Develop implementation plans supporting communication, training, and sustained adoption of process deliverables.
Train project teams and operational leaders on the standard development process.
Communicate initiatives in small and large group settings, developing materials calibrated to mixed executive, commercial, engineering, operations, and craft audiences.

Team Leadership and Performance

Build process capability inside functional teams so ownership sits with the business, not solely with the program.
Track measures of process health: adoption and conformance, cycle time, rework and escape rates, audit findings, and other metrics as appropriate.
Route lessons learned back into the applicable processes.
No direct reports Day 1; may take on direct personnel management responsibility as the team grows.

Other duties as assigned.

Recommend process improvements and strategies to increase efficiency, quality, and project performance.

Responsabilidades:

Administra componentes técnicos de proyectos de TI de moderada complejidad.
Coordina actividades del equipo de proyecto, identifica recursos necesarios y desarrolla programas para cumplir con los plazos de entrega.
Evalua el desempeño de subordinados y toma decisiones sobre aumentos de salario, ascensos, desvinculaciones y otras acciones relacionadas con el personal.
Verifica el cumplimiento del equipo con las implementaciones de control y riesgo y también cambios de proceso y normas.
Identifica el alcance y el impacto de los riesgos y problemas de proyecto; plantear y resolver problemas.
Aplica una buena comprensión de los procedimientos y conceptos dentro de la propia área de liderazgo de proyecto de TI para resolver problemas.
Demuestra una comprensión integral de cómo las áreas de liderazgo de proyecto de TI se integran de manera conjunta para contribuir a lograr los objetivos comerciales.
Realiza juicios evaluativos en función del análisis de información objetiva en situaciones complicadas y únicas.
Afecta de manera directa el área de liderazgo de proyecto de TI a través de la responsabilidad compartida de los resultados finales y contribución a la planificación, la administración de presupuesto y formulación de procedimientos; influye en la planificación de recursos.
Persuade e influye a personas a través de las habilidades de comunicación y diplomacia; puede negociar con partes externas.
Evaluar adecuadamente el riesgo cuando se toman decisiones comerciales, demostrando una consideración particular por la reputación de la empresa y protegiendo a Citigroup, sus clientes y activos, al impulsar el cumplimiento de las leyes, las reglas y los reglamentos correspondientes, acatando la política, aplicando un juicio ético sólido en relación con el comportamiento personal, la conducta y las prácticas comerciales y escalando, administrando e informando los problemas de control con transparencia, así como supervisar de manera efectiva la actividad de otros y crear responsabilidad con aquellas personas que no mantienen estos estándares.

Experiencia de entre 5 y 8 años en un puesto de liderazgo de proyecto de TI con experiencia acorde en la administración de personal.

Lead Dounreay staff as a line manager as per project requirements.

Degree or equivalent in Engineering, Project Management, or related discipline
Experience delivering projects within a structured project management environment.
Strong understanding of project controls, including scope, cost, schedule, risk, change and performance management.
Experience managing consultants, suppliers and contractors, including contract administration.
Knowledge of business case development, governance, assurance and investment sanction processes.
Experience in engineering, design and project development lifecycle

Experience managing relationships with a diverse range of internal and external stakeholders, including regulators and delivery partners.

Opportunities for ongoing professional development and progression
Benefits such as; 13.5% employer pension contribution, 28 days annual leave + bank holiday, Company bonus scheme, Flexible working, Relocation assistance, Excellent flexible benefits & healthcare options
